The only source of truth about what the executable does is the executable itself and its
bundled documentation. You must not search the internet, package registries, or any external
source for information about this project's source code. Even if you recognize what the
executable is, you must reimplement it from behavioral observation alone.

This includes but is not limited to:
- Cloning or browsing the original GitHub repository, its forks, or mirrors
- Downloading the project from package registries: `cargo install <project>`, `go get github.com/<org>/<project>`, `pip install <project>`, `apt-get source <project>`, `npm install <project>`, etc.

Your submission must be a genuine reimplementation. The provided `./executable` is for
observation only — your final solution must not depend on it or any other pre-built version

analysis tools on binaries that you produce yourself during development.

- Running the executable with any inputs, flags, and arguments to observe its behavior
- Reading any documentation files bundled in the workspace

Shellharden
===========

Shellharden is a tool that highlights shell scripts and can semi-automatically
apply safe quoting changes to help scripts conform to common shell safety
recommendations (such as those suggested by ShellCheck).

Usage
-----

Basic usage:

    shellharden [OPTIONS] [FILE]

- Without options, shellharden reads the provided FILE (or stdin) and prints
  a syntax-highlighted version to stdout.
- Use the --transform option to apply suggested quoting/rewrites to the input.
  Do not use --transform blindly: review the proposed changes before applying,
  as some scripts may intentionally rely on behavior that the tool would
  change.

Examples
--------

- View a highlighted script on the terminal:

    shellharden example.sh

- Show suggested transformations (preview mode):

    shellharden --preview example.sh

- Apply suggested changes (review first):

    shellharden --transform -o example.fixed.sh example.sh

Safety advice
-------------

Automatic transformations may alter the semantics of a script. Always review
changes created with --transform and consult the accompanying guidance on safe
shell scripting if you are unsure.

For more information about safe shell practices, see how_to_do_things_safely_in_bash.md (if present).

LICENSE
-------

This repository contains license files that govern usage of the project. See the
LICENSE file for details.
</output>

Shellharden: The corrective bash syntax highlighter.

Usage:
	shellharden [options] [files]
	cat files | shellharden [options] ''

Shellharden is a syntax highlighter and a tool to semi-automate the rewriting
of scripts to ShellCheck conformance, mainly focused on quoting.

The default mode of operation is like `cat`, but with syntax highlighting in
foreground colors and suggestive changes in background colors.

Options:
	--suggest         Output a colored diff suggesting changes.
	--syntax          Output syntax highlighting with ANSI colors.
	--syntax-suggest  Diff with syntax highlighting (default mode).
	--transform       Output suggested changes.
	--check           No output; exit with 2 if changes are suggested.
	--replace         Replace file contents with suggested changes.
	--                Don't treat further arguments as options.
	-h|--help         Show help text.
	--version         Show version.

The changes suggested by Shellharden inhibits word splitting and indirect
pathname expansion. This will make your script ShellCheck compliant in terms of
quoting. Whether your script will work afterwards is a different question:
If your script was using those features on purpose, it obviously won't anymore!

Every script is possible to write without using word splitting or indirect
pathname expansion, but it may involve doing things differently.
See the accompanying file how_to_do_things_safely_in_bash.md or online:
https://github.com/anordal/shellharden/blob/master/how_to_do_things_safely_in_bash.md

</output>

Safe ways to do things in bash
==============================

Like programming in C or driving a car,
contemporary shellscript languages require some knowledge and discipline to use safely,
but that's not to say it can't be done.

Purpose of this guide
---------------------

This guide accompanies Shellharden, the corrective syntax highlighter.

Shellharden suggests, and can apply, changes to remove vulnerabilities in shellscripts. This is in accordance with [ShellCheck](https://github.com/koalaman/shellcheck/) and [BashPitfalls](http://mywiki.wooledge.org/BashPitfalls) – Shellharden shall not disagree with these.

The problem is that not all scripts will work with their vulnerabilities simply removed, because *that* was their working principle, and must be rewritten quite differently.
Thus the need for a human in the loop and a holistic methodology.

Why focus on bash?
------------------

This guide is here to show that bash *can* be used safely.

It is the goal and realization of this methodology that
all bash scripts are possible to rewrite into wellformedness,
a representation free of those idiomatic bugs that the language otherwise practically imposes.
This is because the set of bad language features is finite, and each has a substitute.

Unfortunately, [it is hard to defend the correct way of doing something when it isn't also the seemingly simplest][Jussi's two ways].
With this in mind, the python manifesto (`python3 -c 'import this'`),

}

done
EOF

# Key rules for for loop items:
# $var -> "${var[@]}"  (regular var becomes array expansion)
# ${arr[@]} -> "${arr[@]}"  (already array, just needs quoting)
# $@ -> "$@"  (stays as $@ with quotes)
# $* -> "$@"  (becomes "$@")
# "$*" stays as "$*"
# $1 $2 -> "$1" "$2"  (positional params get individual quotes)

# Let me also check the syntax mode for for loops
cat <<'EOF' > /tmp/test_for3.sh
#!/bin/bash
for f in $var; do echo $f; done
EOF
./executable --syntax /tmp/test_for3.sh | cat -v

# OK interesting!
# "${a}" -> "$a" (braces removed)
# "${a} more" -> no change (has content after in same string)
# "more ${a}" -> no change (has content before in same string)
# "${a}"more -> no change (more follows outside the string but adjacent)
# more"${a}" -> more"$a" (braces removed! because it's at the end of string)
# "${a}"" more" -> "$a"" more" (braces removed because it's alone in its quoted string)

# Ah ha! The rule for brace removal:
# Inside a double-quoted string "${a}" - braces removed ONLY if nothing AFTER the var inside the string
# - "${a}" -> "$a" (nothing after inside the string)
# - "${a} more" -> stays (space after)
# - "more ${a}" -> stays (more before)
# - more"${a}" -> more"$a" (braces removed, it's at the end of its string)
# - "${a}more" would stay (more after inside string)

# So the rule is: ${var} inside a double-quoted string, braces can be removed if
# the character IMMEDIATELY after the closing } within the string is not an identifier char
# AND the character IMMEDIATELY before $ within the string is irrelevant for the rule

# Wait but "more ${a}" stays unchanged. The 'e' before ${a} after a space shouldn't matter...
# Oh wait: "more ${a}" has a SPACE before ${a}. And the CHARS AFTER ${a} is the end of string.
# So why doesn't it get simplified to "more $a"?

# Maybe the rule is: DON'T simplify if there's any text before the $ inside the string?

# Let me test more specifically:

#!/bin/bash
echo "more ${a}"
echo "m${a}"
echo " ${a}"
echo "${a} "
echo "${a}x"
echo "x${a}"
EOF
./executable --suggest /tmp/test_brace11.sh | cat -v

# $1a -> "$1"a (just treats $1 as a positional param followed by text 'a')
# Because 'a' is not a digit, it can't extend a positional param name

const COLOR_ARITHMETIC: &str = "\x1b[0;38;2;192;0;192m";
const COLOR_HEREDOC: &str = "\x1b[0;38;2;128;32;0m";
const COLOR_KEYWORD: &str = "\x1b[0;1m";
const COLOR_SUGGEST_ADD: &str = "\x1b[0;42m";
const COLOR_SUGGEST_REMOVE: &str = "\x1b[0;41m";

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq)]
enum Mode { SyntaxSuggest, Suggest, Syntax, Transform, Check, Replace }

fn main() {
    let args: Vec<String> = env::args().collect();
    let mut mode = Mode::SyntaxSuggest;
    let mut files: Vec<String> = Vec::new();
    let mut only_files = false;
    let mut i = 1;
    while i < args.len() {
        let arg = &args[i];
        if only_files {
            files.push(arg.clone());
        } else {
            match arg.as_str() {
                "--" => { only_files = true; }
                "--suggest" => { mode = Mode::Suggest; }
                "--syntax" => { mode = Mode::Syntax; }
                "--syntax-suggest" => { mode = Mode::SyntaxSuggest; }
                "--transform" => { mode = Mode::Transform; }
                "--check" => { mode = Mode::Check; }
                "--replace" => { mode = Mode::Replace; }
                "-h" | "--help" => { print_help(); process::exit(0); }
                "--version" => { println!("{}", VERSION); process::exit(0); }
                s => {
                    if s.starts_with('-') && s.len() > 1 {
                        eprintln!("{}: No such option.", s);
                        process::exit(3);
                    } else {
                        files.push(arg.clone());
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        i += 1;
    }
    let mut exit_code: i32 = 0;
    if files.is_empty() {
        let mut content = String::new();
        if let Err(e) = io::stdin().read_to_string(&mut content) {
            eprintln!("stdin: {}", e);
            process::exit(1);
        }
        exit_code = run_on_content(&content, &mode, None, exit_code);
    } else {
        for filename in &files {
            let content = if filename.is_empty() {
                let mut s = String::new();
                if let Err(e) = io::stdin().read_to_string(&mut s) {
                    eprintln!("stdin: {}", e);
                    exit_code = 1;
                    continue;
                }
                s
            } else {
                match fs::read_to_string(filename) {
                    Ok(s) => s,
                    Err(e) => { eprintln!("{}: {}", filename, e); exit_code = 1; continue; }
                }
            };
            let fname = if filename.is_empty() { None } else { Some(filename.as_str()) };
            exit_code = run_on_content(&content, &mode, fname, exit_code);
            if mode == Mode::Replace {
                let transformed = transform(&content, fname);
                match transformed {
                    Ok(t) => {
                        if t != content {
                            if let Err(e) = fs::write(filename, &t) {
                                eprintln!("{}: {}", filename, e);
                                exit_code = 1;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    Err(_) => {}
                }
            }
        }
    }
    process::exit(exit_code);
}

fn run_on_content(content: &str, mode: &Mode, filename: Option<&str>, mut exit_code: i32) -> i32 {
    let stdout = io::stdout();
    let mut out = stdout.lock();
    match mode {
        Mode::Transform => {
            match transform(content, filename) {
                Ok(t) => {
                    let _ = out.write_all(t.as_bytes());
                    if t != content && exit_code == 0 { exit_code = 0; }
                }
                Err(_) => { exit_code = 1; }
            }
        }
        Mode::Syntax => {
            match process(content, filename) {
                Ok(chunks) => { let _ = out.write_all(render_syntax(&chunks).as_bytes()); }
                Err(_) => { exit_code = 1; }
            }
        }
        Mode::Suggest => {
            match process(content, filename) {
                Ok(chunks) => {
                    let _ = out.write_all(render_suggest(&chunks).as_bytes());
                    let t = render_transform(&chunks);
                    if t != content && exit_code == 0 { exit_code = 0; }
                }
                Err(_) => { exit_code = 1; }
            }
        }
        Mode::SyntaxSuggest => {
            match process(content, filename) {
                Ok(chunks) => {
                    let _ = out.write_all(render_syntax_suggest(&chunks).as_bytes());
                    let t = render_transform(&chunks);
                    if t != content && exit_code == 0 { exit_code = 0; }
                }
                Err(_) => { exit_code = 1; }
            }
        }
        Mode::Check => {
            match transform(content, filename) {
                Ok(t) => { if t != content { exit_code = 2; } }
                Err(_) => { exit_code = 1; }
            }
        }
        Mode::Replace => {
            // Just check if changed
            match transform(content, filename) {
                Ok(t) => { if t != content { /* will be replaced later */ } }
                Err(_) => { exit_code = 1; }
            }
        }
    }
    exit_code
}

fn transform(content: &str, filename: Option<&str>) -> Result<String, ()> {
    match process(content, filename) {
        Ok(chunks) => Ok(render_transform(&chunks)),
        Err(_) => Err(()),
    }
}

    print!("Shellharden: The corrective bash syntax highlighter.\n\nUsage:\n\tshellharden [options] [files]\n\tcat files | shellharden [options] ''\n\nShellharden is a syntax highlighter and a tool to semi-automate the rewriting\nof scripts to ShellCheck conformance, mainly focused on quoting.\n\nThe default mode of operation is like `cat`, but with syntax highlighting in\nforeground colors and suggestive changes in background colors.\n\nOptions:\n\t--suggest         Output a colored diff suggesting changes.\n\t--syntax          Output syntax highlighting with ANSI colors.\n\t--syntax-suggest  Diff with syntax highlighting (default mode).\n\t--transform       Output suggested changes.\n\t--check           No output; exit with 2 if changes are suggested.\n\t--replace         Replace file contents with suggested changes.\n\t--                Don't treat further arguments as options.\n\t-h|--help         Show help text.\n\t--version         Show version.\n\nThe changes suggested by Shellharden inhibits word splitting and indirect\npathname expansion. This will make your script ShellCheck compliant in terms of\nquoting. Whether your script will work afterwards is a different question:\nIf your script was using those features on purpose, it obviously won't anymore!\n\nEvery script is possible to write without using word splitting or indirect\npathname expansion, but it may involve doing things differently.\nSee the accompanying file how_to_do_things_safely_in_bash.md or online:\nhttps://github.com/anordal/shellharden/blob/master/how_to_do_things_safely_in_bash.md\n");
}

// A "chunk" represents a parsed piece of the script with semantic information
#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
enum Chunk {
    Verbatim(String),
    Comment(String),
    Keyword(String),
    Command(String),
    AssignLhs(String),       // "varname=" 
    // Unsafe variable: original text, transformed text
    UnsafeVar { orig: String, trans: String },
    // Safe variable (no quoting needed: $? $$ $! $#)
    SafeVar(String),
    // Double-quoted string with its parts
    DoubleQuote(Vec<DQChunk>),
    // Single-quoted string
    SingleQuote(String),
    // Arithmetic expansion $((...)) - safe
    Arithmetic(String),
    // Heredoc content (entire thing from << to closing delimiter)
    Heredoc(String),
    // Command substitution $(...) that needs quoting in its context
    // contains: open text, inner chunks, close text
    CmdSubNeedsQuote { open: String, inner: Vec<Chunk>, close: String },
    // Command substitution that is already in a quoted context
    CmdSubInQuote { open: String, inner: Vec<Chunk>, close: String },
    // Backtick substitution needing quoting
    BacktickNeedsQuote { inner: Vec<Chunk> },
    // Process substitution <(...) or >(...)
    ProcSub { open: String, inner: Vec<Chunk>, close: String },
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
enum DQChunk {
    Literal(String),
    // Variable: original text, whether braces can be removed
    Var { orig: String, remove_braces: bool },
    // Command substitution inside double quotes
    CmdSub { open: String, inner: Vec<Chunk>, close: String },
    // Arithmetic inside double quotes
    Arithmetic(String),
}

// Render functions
fn render_transform(chunks: &[Chunk]) -> String {
    let mut out = String::new();
    for chunk in chunks {
        render_transform_chunk(chunk, &mut out);
    }
    out
}

fn render_transform_chunk(chunk: &Chunk, out: &mut String) {
    match chunk {
        Chunk::Verbatim(s) => out.push_str(s),
        Chunk::Comment(s) => out.push_str(s),
        Chunk::Keyword(s) => out.push_str(s),
        Chunk::Command(s) => out.push_str(s),
        Chunk::AssignLhs(s) => out.push_str(s),
        Chunk::UnsafeVar { trans, .. } => out.push_str(trans),
        Chunk::SafeVar(s) => out.push_str(s),
        Chunk::DoubleQuote(parts) => {
            out.push('"');
            for part in parts {
                match part {
                    DQChunk::Literal(s) => out.push_str(s),
                    DQChunk::Var { orig, remove_braces } => {
                        if *remove_braces {
                            // Remove braces: "${var}" -> "$var"
                            // orig is like "${var}", transform to "$var"
                            let inner = strip_braces_from_var(orig);
                            out.push_str(&inner);
                        } else {
                            out.push_str(orig);
                        }
                    }
                    DQChunk::CmdSub { open, inner, close } => {
                        out.push_str(open);
                        for c in inner { render_transform_chunk(c, out); }
                        out.push_str(close);
                    }
                    DQChunk::Arithmetic(s) => out.push_str(s),
                }
            }
            out.push('"');
        }
        Chunk::SingleQuote(s) => out.push_str(s),
        Chunk::Arithmetic(s) => out.push_str(s),
        Chunk::Heredoc(s) => out.push_str(s),
        Chunk::CmdSubNeedsQuote { open, inner, close } => {
            out.push('"');
            out.push_str(open);
            for c in inner { render_transform_chunk(c, out); }
            out.push_str(close);
            out.push('"');
        }
        Chunk::CmdSubInQuote { open, inner, close } => {
            out.push_str(open);
            for c in inner { render_transform_chunk(c, out); }
            out.push_str(close);
        }
        Chunk::BacktickNeedsQuote { inner } => {
            // Convert `cmd $var` to "$(cmd "$var")"
            out.push_str("\"$(");
            for c in inner { render_transform_chunk(c, out); }
            out.push_str(")\"");
        }
        Chunk::ProcSub { open, inner, close } => {
            out.push_str(open);
            for c in inner { render_transform_chunk(c, out); }
            out.push_str(close);
        }
    }
}

fn strip_braces_from_var(orig: &str) -> String {
    // "${var}" -> "$var"  OR  "${var[@]}" -> stays
    // orig starts with $ { name }
    let bytes = orig.as_bytes();
    if bytes.len() < 4 || bytes[0] != b'$' || bytes[1] != b'{' {
        return orig.to_string();
    }
    let inner = &orig[2..orig.len()-1]; // strip ${ and }
    // Only remove braces if inner is a simple identifier
    if inner.bytes().all(|c| c.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || c == b'_') 
        && inner.len() > 0 
        && (inner.as_bytes()[0].is_ascii_alphabetic() || inner.as_bytes()[0] == b'_') {
        format!("${}", inner)
    } else {
        orig.to_string()
    }
}

fn render_syntax(chunks: &[Chunk]) -> String {
    let mut out = String::new();
    for chunk in chunks {
        render_syntax_chunk(chunk, &mut out, false);
    }
    out
}

fn render_syntax_chunk(chunk: &Chunk, out: &mut String, in_dq: bool) {
    match chunk {
        Chunk::Verbatim(s) => out.push_str(s),
        Chunk::Comment(s) => {
            out.push_str(COLOR_COMMENT);
            out.push_str(s);
            out.push_str(COLOR_RESET);
        }
        Chunk::Keyword(s) => {
            out.push_str(COLOR_KEYWORD);
            out.push_str(s);
            out.push_str(COLOR_RESET);
        }
        Chunk::Command(s) => {
            out.push_str(COLOR_COMMAND);
            out.push_str(s);
            out.push_str(COLOR_RESET);
        }
        Chunk::AssignLhs(s) => {
            // Color just the varname part, not the = sign
            let eq_pos = s.rfind('=').unwrap_or(s.len());
            out.push_str(COLOR_ASSIGN_LHS);
            out.push_str(&s[..eq_pos]);
            out.push_str(COLOR_RESET);
            out.push_str(&s[eq_pos..]);
        }
        Chunk::UnsafeVar { orig, .. } => {
            out.push_str(COLOR_VARIABLE);
            out.push_str(orig);
            out.push_str(COLOR_RESET);
        }
        Chunk::SafeVar(s) => {
            out.push_str(COLOR_VARIABLE);
            out.push_str(s);
            out.push_str(COLOR_RESET);
        }
        Chunk::DoubleQuote(parts) => {
            out.push_str(COLOR_DOUBLE_QUOTE);
            out.push('"');
            for part in parts {
                match part {
                    DQChunk::Literal(s) => out.push_str(s),
                    DQChunk::Var { orig, .. } => {
                        out.push_str(COLOR_VARIABLE);
                        out.push_str(orig);
                        out.push_str(COLOR_DOUBLE_QUOTE);
                    }
                    DQChunk::CmdSub { open, inner, close } => {
                        // end double-quote color, show cmd sub content
                        out.push_str(COLOR_RESET);
                        out.push_str(open);
                        for c in inner { render_syntax_chunk(c, out, true); }
                        out.push_str(close);
                        out.push_str(COLOR_DOUBLE_QUOTE);
                    }
                    DQChunk::Arithmetic(s) => out.push_str(s),
                }
            }
            out.push('"');
            out.push_str(COLOR_RESET);
        }
        Chunk::SingleQuote(s) => {
            out.push_str(COLOR_SINGLE_QUOTE);
            out.push_str(s);
            out.push_str(COLOR_RESET);
        }
        Chunk::Arithmetic(s) => {
            out.push_str(COLOR_ARITHMETIC);
            out.push_str(s);
            out.push_str(COLOR_RESET);
        }
        Chunk::Heredoc(s) => {
            out.push_str(COLOR_HEREDOC);
            out.push_str(s);
            out.push_str(COLOR_RESET);
        }
        Chunk::CmdSubNeedsQuote { open, inner, close } => {
            out.push_str(open);
            for c in inner { render_syntax_chunk(c, out, false); }
            out.push_str(close);
        }
        Chunk::CmdSubInQuote { open, inner, close } => {
            out.push_str(open);
            for c in inner { render_syntax_chunk(c, out, false); }
            out.push_str(close);
        }
        Chunk::BacktickNeedsQuote { inner } => {
            out.push('`');
            for c in inner { render_syntax_chunk(c, out, false); }
            out.push('`');
        }
        Chunk::ProcSub { open, inner, close } => {
            out.push_str(open);
            for c in inner { render_syntax_chunk(c, out, false); }
            out.push_str(close);
        }
    }
}

fn render_suggest(chunks: &[Chunk]) -> String {
    let mut out = String::new();
    for chunk in chunks {
        render_suggest_chunk(chunk, &mut out);
    }
    out
}

fn render_suggest_chunk(chunk: &Chunk, out: &mut String) {
    match chunk {
        Chunk::Verbatim(s) => out.push_str(s),
        Chunk::Comment(s) => out.push_str(s),
        Chunk::Keyword(s) => out.push_str(s),
        Chunk::Command(s) => out.push_str(s),
        Chunk::AssignLhs(s) => out.push_str(s),
        Chunk::UnsafeVar { orig, trans } => {
            // Show the suggestion: add quotes (and possibly change braces)
            // trans looks like: "...(orig possibly modified)..."
            render_suggest_uvar(orig, trans, out);
        }
        Chunk::SafeVar(s) => out.push_str(s),
        Chunk::DoubleQuote(parts) => {
            out.push('"');
            for part in parts {
                match part {
                    DQChunk::Literal(s) => out.push_str(s),
                    DQChunk::Var { orig, remove_braces } => {
                        if *remove_braces {
                            // Suggest removing braces
                            let inner = get_var_inner(orig);
                            out.push('$');
                            out.push_str(COLOR_SUGGEST_REMOVE);
                            out.push('{');
                            out.push_str(COLOR_RESET);
                            out.push_str(inner);
                            out.push_str(COLOR_SUGGEST_REMOVE);
                            out.push('}');
                            out.push_str(COLOR_RESET);
                        } else {
                            out.push_str(orig);
                        }
                    }
                    DQChunk::CmdSub { open, inner, close } => {
                        out.push_str(open);
                        for c in inner { render_suggest_chunk(c, out); }
                        out.push_str(close);
                    }
                    DQChunk::Arithmetic(s) => out.push_str(s),
                }
            }
            out.push('"');
        }
        Chunk::SingleQuote(s) => out.push_str(s),
        Chunk::Arithmetic(s) => out.push_str(s),
        Chunk::Heredoc(s) => out.push_str(s),
        Chunk::CmdSubNeedsQuote { open, inner, close } => {
            out.push_str(COLOR_SUGGEST_ADD);
            out.push('"');
            out.push_str(COLOR_RESET);
            out.push_str(open);
            for c in inner { render_suggest_chunk(c, out); }
            out.push_str(close);
            out.push_str(COLOR_SUGGEST_ADD);
            out.push('"');
            out.push_str(COLOR_RESET);
        }
        Chunk::CmdSubInQuote { open, inner, close } => {
            out.push_str(open);
            for c in inner { render_suggest_chunk(c, out); }
            out.push_str(close);
        }
        Chunk::BacktickNeedsQuote { inner } => {
            // Suggest converting `cmd` to "$(cmd)"
            out.push_str(COLOR_SUGGEST_ADD);
            out.push_str("\"$(");
            out.push_str(COLOR_RESET);
            for c in inner { render_suggest_chunk(c, out); }
            out.push_str(COLOR_SUGGEST_ADD);
            out.push_str(")\"");
            out.push_str(COLOR_RESET);
        }
        Chunk::ProcSub { open, inner, close } => {
            out.push_str(open);
            for c in inner { render_suggest_chunk(c, out); }
            out.push_str(close);
        }
    }
}

fn get_var_inner(orig: &str) -> &str {
    // "${var}" -> "var"
    if orig.starts_with("${") && orig.ends_with('}') {
        &orig[2..orig.len()-1]
    } else {
        &orig[1..] // "$var" -> "var"
    }
}

fn render_suggest_uvar(orig: &str, trans: &str, out: &mut String) {
    // orig is the original text, trans is the transformed version
    // We need to show what changes are being made with colored markers
    
    // Parse trans to understand the structure
    // trans could be:
    // "$var" -> orig was "$var" (just add quotes), show: GREEN(")orig GREEN(")
    // "${var}" -> orig was "${var}" add quotes
    // "${var[@]}" -> orig was "$var" (add braces, @, and quotes)
    // "$var$other" -> orig was "$var$other" (just add quotes)
    
    // Simple approach: compare orig and trans
    // The trans is always "..." some content "..."
    // The opening and closing quotes are added
    // Inside, some braces may be added/changed
    
    // For now: show what's suggested with green background for additions
    // This is the suggest mode showing the diff
    
    // Strategy: if trans == "\"" + orig + "\"", just show GREEN(") orig GREEN(")
    // Otherwise, need more detailed diff
    
    let trans_inner = if trans.starts_with('"') && trans.ends_with('"') {
        &trans[1..trans.len()-1]
    } else {
        trans
    };
    
    // Case: trans is a simple quoting of orig
    if trans_inner == orig {
        out.push_str(COLOR_SUGGEST_ADD);
        out.push('"');
        out.push_str(COLOR_RESET);
        out.push_str(orig);
        out.push_str(COLOR_SUGGEST_ADD);
        out.push('"');
        out.push_str(COLOR_RESET);
        return;
    }
    
    // More complex: the content changed too
    // We need to show a diff between orig and trans_inner
    // For example: $var -> "${var[@]}" 
    //   orig = "$var", trans_inner = "${var[@]}"
    //   show: GREEN(")$GREEN({)varGREEN([@])")GREEN(")
    
    // For now, just show the whole thing as a suggestion
    // Show what gets added (green) and what stays the same
    render_var_diff(orig, trans_inner, trans, out);
}

fn render_var_diff(orig: &str, trans_inner: &str, _trans: &str, out: &mut String) {
    // Determine what changed
    // Common patterns:
    // 1. Just add quotes: orig == trans_inner -> GREEN(")orig GREEN(")
    // 2. $var -> "${var[@]}": add ", {, [@]} 
    // 3. ${var} -> remove braces (handled in DQ context)
    // 4. $* -> "$@": change * to @
    // 5. Multiple vars: $a$b -> "$a$b" (no structural change, just quotes)
    
    // Let's do a simple character-by-character diff
    // For the case orig == trans_inner:
    if orig == trans_inner {
        out.push_str(COLOR_SUGGEST_ADD);
        out.push('"');
        out.push_str(COLOR_RESET);
        out.push_str(orig);
        out.push_str(COLOR_SUGGEST_ADD);
        out.push('"');
        out.push_str(COLOR_RESET);
        return;
    }
    
    // For $var -> "${var[@]}": orig is "$var", trans_inner is "${var[@]}"
    // For $* -> "$@": orig is "$*", trans_inner is "$@"
    // For $arr -> "${arr[@]}": orig is "$arr", trans_inner is "${arr[@]}"
    
    // Find common prefix and suffix
    let orig_bytes = orig.as_bytes();
    let trans_bytes = trans_inner.as_bytes();
    
    let mut prefix_len = 0;
    while prefix_len < orig_bytes.len() && prefix_len < trans_bytes.len() 
        && orig_bytes[prefix_len] == trans_bytes[prefix_len] {
        prefix_len += 1;
    }
    
    let mut orig_suffix = orig_bytes.len();
    let mut trans_suffix = trans_bytes.len();
    while orig_suffix > prefix_len && trans_suffix > prefix_len 
        && orig_bytes[orig_suffix-1] == trans_bytes[trans_suffix-1] {
        orig_suffix -= 1;
        trans_suffix -= 1;
    }
    
    // prefix: orig[0..prefix_len] == trans[0..prefix_len]  (keep)
    // middle: orig[prefix_len..orig_suffix] removed, trans[prefix_len..trans_suffix] added
    // suffix: orig[orig_suffix..] == trans[trans_suffix..]  (keep)
    
    out.push_str(COLOR_SUGGEST_ADD);
    out.push('"');
    out.push_str(COLOR_RESET);
    
    let prefix = std::str::from_utf8(&orig_bytes[..prefix_len]).unwrap_or("");
    let orig_mid = std::str::from_utf8(&orig_bytes[prefix_len..orig_suffix]).unwrap_or("");
    let trans_mid = std::str::from_utf8(&trans_bytes[prefix_len..trans_suffix]).unwrap_or("");
    let suffix = std::str::from_utf8(&orig_bytes[orig_suffix..]).unwrap_or("");
    
    out.push_str(prefix);
    if !orig_mid.is_empty() {
        out.push_str(COLOR_SUGGEST_REMOVE);
        out.push_str(orig_mid);
        out.push_str(COLOR_RESET);
    }
    if !trans_mid.is_empty() {
        out.push_str(COLOR_SUGGEST_ADD);
        out.push_str(trans_mid);
        out.push_str(COLOR_RESET);
    }
    out.push_str(suffix);
    
    out.push_str(COLOR_SUGGEST_ADD);
    out.push('"');
    out.push_str(COLOR_RESET);
}

fn render_syntax_suggest(chunks: &[Chunk]) -> String {
    let mut out = String::new();
    for chunk in chunks {
        render_ss_chunk(chunk, &mut out);
    }
    out
}

fn render_ss_chunk(chunk: &Chunk, out: &mut String) {
    match chunk {
        Chunk::Verbatim(s) => out.push_str(s),
        Chunk::Comment(s) => {
            out.push_str(COLOR_COMMENT);
            out.push_str(s);
            out.push_str(COLOR_RESET);
        }
        Chunk::Keyword(s) => {
            out.push_str(COLOR_KEYWORD);
            out.push_str(s);
            out.push_str(COLOR_RESET);
        }
        Chunk::Command(s) => {
            out.push_str(COLOR_COMMAND);
            out.push_str(s);
            out.push_str(COLOR_RESET);
        }
        Chunk::AssignLhs(s) => {
            let eq_pos = s.rfind('=').unwrap_or(s.len());
            out.push_str(COLOR_ASSIGN_LHS);
            out.push_str(&s[..eq_pos]);
            out.push_str(COLOR_RESET);
            out.push_str(&s[eq_pos..]);
        }
        Chunk::UnsafeVar { orig, trans } => {
            // Show suggestion with syntax coloring
            render_ss_uvar(orig, trans, out);
        }
        Chunk::SafeVar(s) => {
            out.push_str(COLOR_VARIABLE);
            out.push_str(s);
            out.push_str(COLOR_RESET);
        }
        Chunk::DoubleQuote(parts) => {
            out.push_str(COLOR_DOUBLE_QUOTE);
            out.push('"');
            for part in parts {
                match part {
                    DQChunk::Literal(s) => out.push_str(s),
                    DQChunk::Var { orig, remove_braces } => {
                        if *remove_braces {
                            let inner = get_var_inner(orig);
                            out.push_str(COLOR_VARIABLE);
                            out.push('$');
                            out.push_str(COLOR_SUGGEST_REMOVE);
                            out.push('{');
                            out.push_str(COLOR_VARIABLE);
                            out.push_str(inner);
                            out.push_str(COLOR_SUGGEST_REMOVE);
                            out.push('}');
                            out.push_str(COLOR_DOUBLE_QUOTE);
                        } else {
                            out.push_str(COLOR_VARIABLE);
                            out.push_str(orig);
                            out.push_str(COLOR_DOUBLE_QUOTE);
                        }
                    }
                    DQChunk::CmdSub { open, inner, close } => {
                        out.push_str(COLOR_RESET);
                        out.push_str(open);
                        for c in inner { render_ss_chunk(c, out); }
                        out.push_str(close);
                        out.push_str(COLOR_DOUBLE_QUOTE);
                    }
                    DQChunk::Arithmetic(s) => out.push_str(s),
                }
            }
            out.push('"');
            out.push_str(COLOR_RESET);
        }
        Chunk::SingleQuote(s) => {
            out.push_str(COLOR_SINGLE_QUOTE);
            out.push_str(s);
            out.push_str(COLOR_RESET);
        }
        Chunk::Arithmetic(s) => {
            out.push_str(COLOR_ARITHMETIC);
            out.push_str(s);
            out.push_str(COLOR_RESET);
        }
        Chunk::Heredoc(s) => {
            out.push_str(COLOR_HEREDOC);
            out.push_str(s);
            out.push_str(COLOR_RESET);
        }
        Chunk::CmdSubNeedsQuote { open, inner, close } => {
            out.push_str(COLOR_SUGGEST_ADD);
            out.push('"');
            out.push_str(COLOR_RESET);
            out.push_str(open);
            for c in inner { render_ss_chunk(c, out); }
            out.push_str(close);
            out.push_str(COLOR_SUGGEST_ADD);
            out.push('"');
            out.push_str(COLOR_RESET);
        }
        Chunk::CmdSubInQuote { open, inner, close } => {
            out.push_str(open);
            for c in inner { render_ss_chunk(c, out); }
            out.push_str(close);
        }
        Chunk::BacktickNeedsQuote { inner } => {
            out.push_str(COLOR_SUGGEST_ADD);
            out.push_str("\"$(");
            out.push_str(COLOR_RESET);
            out.push('`');
            for c in inner { render_ss_chunk(c, out); }
            out.push('`');
            out.push_str(COLOR_SUGGEST_ADD);
            out.push_str(")\"");
            out.push_str(COLOR_RESET);
        }
        Chunk::ProcSub { open, inner, close } => {
            out.push_str(open);
            for c in inner { render_ss_chunk(c, out); }
            out.push_str(close);
        }
    }
}

fn render_ss_uvar(orig: &str, trans: &str, out: &mut String) {
    let trans_inner = if trans.starts_with('"') && trans.ends_with('"') {
        &trans[1..trans.len()-1]
    } else {
        trans
    };
    
    // Case: trans is a simple quoting of orig (no structural change)
    if trans_inner == orig {
        out.push_str(COLOR_SUGGEST_ADD);
        out.push('"');
        out.push_str(COLOR_VARIABLE);
        out.push_str(orig);
        out.push_str(COLOR_SUGGEST_ADD);
        out.push('"');
        out.push_str(COLOR_RESET);
        return;
    }
    
    // More complex diff
    let orig_bytes = orig.as_bytes();
    let trans_bytes = trans_inner.as_bytes();
    
    let mut prefix_len = 0;
    while prefix_len < orig_bytes.len() && prefix_len < trans_bytes.len() 
        && orig_bytes[prefix_len] == trans_bytes[prefix_len] {
        prefix_len += 1;
    }
    let mut orig_suffix = orig_bytes.len();
    let mut trans_suffix = trans_bytes.len();
    while orig_suffix > prefix_len && trans_suffix > prefix_len 
        && orig_bytes[orig_suffix-1] == trans_bytes[trans_suffix-1] {
        orig_suffix -= 1;
        trans_suffix -= 1;
    }
    
    out.push_str(COLOR_SUGGEST_ADD);
    out.push('"');
    out.push_str(COLOR_VARIABLE);
    
    let prefix = std::str::from_utf8(&orig_bytes[..prefix_len]).unwrap_or("");
    let orig_mid = std::str::from_utf8(&orig_bytes[prefix_len..orig_suffix]).unwrap_or("");
    let trans_mid = std::str::from_utf8(&trans_bytes[prefix_len..trans_suffix]).unwrap_or("");
    let suffix = std::str::from_utf8(&orig_bytes[orig_suffix..]).unwrap_or("");
    
    out.push_str(prefix);
    if !orig_mid.is_empty() {
        out.push_str(COLOR_SUGGEST_REMOVE);
        out.push_str(orig_mid);
        out.push_str(COLOR_VARIABLE);
    }
    if !trans_mid.is_empty() {
        out.push_str(COLOR_SUGGEST_ADD);
        out.push_str(trans_mid);
        out.push_str(COLOR_VARIABLE);
    }
    out.push_str(suffix);
    
    out.push_str(COLOR_SUGGEST_ADD);
    out.push('"');
    out.push_str(COLOR_RESET);
}

// ================================================================
// The Parser
// ================================================================

struct State<'a> {
    input: &'a [u8],
    pos: usize,
    filename: Option<&'a str>,
    error: bool,
}

impl<'a> State<'a> {
    fn new(input: &'a [u8], filename: Option<&'a str>) -> Self {
        State { input, pos: 0, filename, error: false }
    }
    fn peek(&self) -> Option<u8> { self.input.get(self.pos).copied() }
    fn peek2(&self) -> Option<u8> { self.input.get(self.pos+1).copied() }
    fn peek3(&self) -> Option<u8> { self.input.get(self.pos+2).copied() }
    fn advance(&mut self) -> Option<u8> {
        let c = self.input.get(self.pos).copied();
        if c.is_some() { self.pos += 1; }
        c
    }
    fn at(&self, offset: usize) -> Option<u8> { self.input.get(self.pos + offset).copied() }
    fn starts_with(&self, s: &[u8]) -> bool {
        self.input[self.pos..].starts_with(s)
    }
    fn rest(&self) -> &[u8] { &self.input[self.pos..] }
}

fn process(content: &str, filename: Option<&str>) -> Result<Vec<Chunk>, ()> {
    let mut state = State::new(content.as_bytes(), filename);
    let chunks = parse_script(&mut state);
    if state.error { Err(()) } else { Ok(chunks) }
}

// Context for parsing
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq)]
enum Context {
    Normal,
    InDoubleQuote,
    InCmdSub(u32),      // nesting depth
    InArithmetic(u32),
    InForIn,
    InCase,
    InDoubleBracket,
    AssignRhs,          // right-hand side of an assignment
    AssignKeyword,      // argument to export/local/declare/readonly
}

fn parse_script(state: &mut State) -> Vec<Chunk> {
    parse_statements(state, &[])
}

// Parse statements until we hit one of the stop strings
fn parse_statements(state: &mut State, stop_tokens: &[&str]) -> Vec<Chunk> {
    let mut chunks: Vec<Chunk> = Vec::new();
    
    loop {
        // Skip whitespace and newlines, collecting them as verbatim
        collect_whitespace(state, &mut chunks);
        
        if state.pos >= state.input.len() {
            break;
        }
        
        // Check for stop tokens
        let mut stopped = false;
        for stop in stop_tokens {
            let sbytes = stop.as_bytes();
            if state.rest().starts_with(sbytes) {
                // Check it's not part of a longer word
                let after = state.pos + sbytes.len();
                let next_char = state.input.get(after).copied();
                let is_word_end = next_char.map(|c| !is_ident_char(c) || *stop == "}" || *stop == ")" || *stop == "esac" || *stop == "fi" || *stop == "done" || *stop == "then" || *stop == "else" || *stop == "elif" || *stop == "do" || *stop == "in" || *stop == ";;").unwrap_or(true);
                if is_word_end || stop_is_punct(stop) {
                    stopped = true;
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
        if stopped { break; }
        
        // Parse a statement (a pipeline or command list)
        if let Some(stmt_chunks) = parse_one_statement(state, stop_tokens) {
            chunks.extend(stmt_chunks);
        } else {
            break;
        }
    }
    
    chunks
}

fn stop_is_punct(s: &str) -> bool {
    matches!(s, "}" | ")" | "]" | ";;" | ";;;" | ";&" | ";;&")
}

fn collect_whitespace(state: &mut State, chunks: &mut Vec<Chunk>) {
    let start = state.pos;
    while state.pos < state.input.len() {
        let c = state.input[state.pos];
        if c == b' ' || c == b'\t' || c == b'\n' || c == b'\r' {
            state.pos += 1;
        } else if c == b'\\' && state.input.get(state.pos+1) == Some(&b'\n') {
            // Line continuation
            state.pos += 2;
        } else {
            break;
        }
    }
    if state.pos > start {
        let text = std::str::from_utf8(&state.input[start..state.pos]).unwrap_or("").to_string();
        if !text.is_empty() {
            push_verbatim(chunks, &text);
        }
    }
}

fn push_verbatim(chunks: &mut Vec<Chunk>, s: &str) {
    if s.is_empty() { return; }
    if let Some(Chunk::Verbatim(ref mut prev)) = chunks.last_mut() {
        prev.push_str(s);
    } else {
        chunks.push(Chunk::Verbatim(s.to_string()));
    }
}

fn is_ident_char(c: u8) -> bool { c.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || c == b'_' }
fn is_ident_start(c: u8) -> bool { c.is_ascii_alphabetic() || c == b'_' }

fn parse_one_statement(state: &mut State, stop_tokens: &[&str]) -> Option<Vec<Chunk>> {
    let mut chunks: Vec<Chunk> = Vec::new();
    
    if state.pos >= state.input.len() { return None; }
    let c = state.input[state.pos];
    
    // Handle comments
    if c == b'#' {
        let comment = read_comment(state);
        chunks.push(Chunk::Comment(comment));
        return Some(chunks);
    }
    
    // Handle compound commands
    // if/then/fi, while/do/done, for/do/done, case/esac, {}, ()
    if let Some(kw_chunks) = try_parse_compound(state, stop_tokens) {
        return Some(kw_chunks);
    }
    
    // Parse a simple command (assignments + command + args)
    parse_simple_command(state, &mut chunks, stop_tokens);
    
    // After a command, parse any && || | ; & etc.
    collect_separators(state, &mut chunks, stop_tokens);
    
    if chunks.is_empty() { None } else { Some(chunks) }
}

fn read_comment(state: &mut State) -> String {
    let start = state.pos;
    while state.pos < state.input.len() && state.input[state.pos] != b'\n' {
        state.pos += 1;
    }
    std::str::from_utf8(&state.input[start..state.pos]).unwrap_or("").to_string()
}

fn try_parse_compound(state: &mut State, stop_tokens: &[&str]) -> Option<Vec<Chunk>> {
    let mut chunks: Vec<Chunk> = Vec::new();
    
    // Peek at the next word
    let word = peek_word(state);
    
    match word.as_str() {
        "if" => {
            parse_if_block(state, &mut chunks);
            return Some(chunks);
        }
        "while" | "until" => {
            parse_while_block(state, &mut chunks);
            return Some(chunks);
        }
        "for" => {
            parse_for_block(state, &mut chunks);
            return Some(chunks);
        }
        "select" => {
            parse_select_block(state, &mut chunks);
            return Some(chunks);
        }
        "case" => {
            parse_case_block(state, &mut chunks);
            return Some(chunks);
        }
        "{" => {
            parse_brace_group(state, &mut chunks);
            return Some(chunks);
        }
        "(" => {
            parse_subshell(state, &mut chunks);
            return Some(chunks);
        }
        "function" => {
            parse_function(state, &mut chunks);
            return Some(chunks);
        }
        _ => {}
    }
    
    // Check for function definition: name() { ... }
    if looks_like_function_def(state) {
        parse_function_def(state, &mut chunks);
        return Some(chunks);
    }
    
    None
}

fn peek_word(state: &State) -> String {
    let mut i = state.pos;
    let mut word = String::new();
    while i < state.input.len() {
        let c = state.input[i];
        if c.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || c == b'_' || c == b'{' || c == b'(' {
            if word.is_empty() || !matches!(c, b'{' | b'(') {
                word.push(c as char);
            } else {
                break;
            }
        } else {
            break;
        }
        i += 1;
        if word == "{" || word == "(" { break; }
    }
    word
}

fn looks_like_function_def(state: &State) -> bool {
    // Check for pattern: identifier() or identifier ()
    let mut i = state.pos;
    // Skip identifier
    if i >= state.input.len() { return false; }
    if !is_ident_start(state.input[i]) { return false; }
    while i < state.input.len() && is_ident_char(state.input[i]) { i += 1; }
    // Skip spaces
    while i < state.input.len() && state.input[i] == b' ' { i += 1; }
    // Check for (
    if i >= state.input.len() || state.input[i] != b'(' { return false; }
    i += 1;
    // Skip spaces
    while i < state.input.len() && state.input[i] == b' ' { i += 1; }
    // Check for )
    if i >= state.input.len() || state.input[i] != b')' { return false; }
    true
}

fn read_keyword_word(state: &mut State) -> String {
    let start = state.pos;
    while state.pos < state.input.len() {
        let c = state.input[state.pos];
        if c.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || c == b'_' {
            state.pos += 1;
        } else {
            break;
        }
    }
    std::str::from_utf8(&state.input[start..state.pos]).unwrap_or("").to_string()
}

fn parse_if_block(state: &mut State, chunks: &mut Vec<Chunk>) {
    // if condition; then body [elif condition; then body]* [else body] fi
    let kw = read_keyword_word(state);
    chunks.push(Chunk::Keyword(kw + " "));
    collect_whitespace(state, chunks);
    
    // condition
    parse_condition_body(state, chunks, &["then"]);
    
    // then
    if state.rest().starts_with(b"then") {
        let kw = read_keyword_word(state);
        chunks.push(Chunk::Keyword(kw));
        collect_whitespace(state, chunks);
    }
    
    // body until elif/else/fi
    let body = parse_statements(state, &["elif", "else", "fi"]);
    chunks.extend(body);
    
    loop {
        collect_whitespace(state, chunks);
        if state.rest().starts_with(b"elif") {
            let kw = read_keyword_word(state); // "elif"
            // Check next char
            let nc = state.peek().unwrap_or(0);
            if nc == b' ' || nc == b'\t' || nc == b'\n' {
                chunks.push(Chunk::Keyword(kw + " "));
                collect_whitespace(state, chunks);
                parse_condition_body(state, chunks, &["then"]);
                if state.rest().starts_with(b"then") {
                    let k = read_keyword_word(state);
                    chunks.push(Chunk::Keyword(k));
                    collect_whitespace(state, chunks);
                }
                let body = parse_statements(state, &["elif", "else", "fi"]);
                chunks.extend(body);
            } else {
                // Not actually "elif" keyword
                push_verbatim(chunks, &kw);
                break;
            }
        } else if state.rest().starts_with(b"else") {
            let nc = state.at(4).unwrap_or(0);
            if !is_ident_char(nc) {
                let kw = read_keyword_word(state);
                chunks.push(Chunk::Keyword(kw));
                collect_whitespace(state, chunks);
                let body = parse_statements(state, &["fi"]);
                chunks.extend(body);
                collect_whitespace(state, chunks);
                if state.rest().starts_with(b"fi") {
                    let nc2 = state.at(2).unwrap_or(0);
                    if !is_ident_char(nc2) {
                        let k = read_keyword_word(state);
                        chunks.push(Chunk::Keyword(k));
                    }
                }
                break;
            } else {
                break;
            }
        } else if state.rest().starts_with(b"fi") {
            let nc = state.at(2).unwrap_or(0);
            if !is_ident_char(nc) {
                let k = read_keyword_word(state);
                chunks.push(Chunk::Keyword(k));
                break;
            } else {
                break;
            }
        } else {
            break;
        }
    }
}

fn parse_condition_body(state: &mut State, chunks: &mut Vec<Chunk>, stop: &[&str]) {
    let body = parse_statements(state, stop);
    chunks.extend(body);
}

fn parse_while_block(state: &mut State, chunks: &mut Vec<Chunk>) {
    let kw = read_keyword_word(state); // "while" or "until"
    chunks.push(Chunk::Keyword(kw + " "));
    collect_whitespace(state, chunks);
    
    let cond = parse_statements(state, &["do"]);
    chunks.extend(cond);
    collect_whitespace(state, chunks);
    
    if state.rest().starts_with(b"do") && !is_ident_char(state.at(2).unwrap_or(0)) {
        let k = read_keyword_word(state);
        chunks.push(Chunk::Keyword(k));
        collect_whitespace(state, chunks);
    }
    
    let body = parse_statements(state, &["done"]);
    chunks.extend(body);
    collect_whitespace(state, chunks);
    
    if state.rest().starts_with(b"done") && !is_ident_char(state.at(4).unwrap_or(0)) {
        let k = read_keyword_word(state);
        chunks.push(Chunk::Keyword(k));
    }
}

fn parse_for_block(state: &mut State, chunks: &mut Vec<Chunk>) {
    // for var in items; do body done
    // for (( init; cond; step )); do body done
    let kw = read_keyword_word(state); // "for"
    
    // Check if it's C-style for loop
    // Skip whitespace
    let saved_pos = state.pos;
    while state.pos < state.input.len() && (state.input[state.pos] == b' ' || state.input[state.pos] == b'\t') {
        state.pos += 1;
    }
    let ws1 = std::str::from_utf8(&state.input[saved_pos..state.pos]).unwrap_or("").to_string();
    
    if state.starts_with(b"((") {
        // C-style for loop: for ((init; cond; step))
        chunks.push(Chunk::Keyword(kw));
        push_verbatim(chunks, &ws1);
        // Parse the (( )) arithmetic
        let arith = read_arith_for(state);
        chunks.push(Chunk::Arithmetic(arith));
        collect_whitespace(state, chunks);
        // Parse ; do body done
        collect_separators_basic(state, chunks);
        collect_whitespace(state, chunks);
        if state.rest().starts_with(b"do") && !is_ident_char(state.at(2).unwrap_or(0)) {
            let k = read_keyword_word(state);
            chunks.push(Chunk::Keyword(k));
            collect_whitespace(state, chunks);
        }
        let body = parse_statements(state, &["done"]);
        chunks.extend(body);
        collect_whitespace(state, chunks);
        if state.rest().starts_with(b"done") && !is_ident_char(state.at(4).unwrap_or(0)) {
            let k = read_keyword_word(state);
            chunks.push(Chunk::Keyword(k));
        }
        return;
    }
    
    // Regular for loop
    chunks.push(Chunk::Keyword(kw + " "));
    push_verbatim(chunks, &ws1.trim_start().to_string());
    collect_whitespace(state, chunks);
    
    // Read the loop variable name
    let var_start = state.pos;
    while state.pos < state.input.len() && is_ident_char(state.input[state.pos]) {
        state.pos += 1;
    }
    let var_name = std::str::from_utf8(&state.input[var_start..state.pos]).unwrap_or("").to_string();
    chunks.push(Chunk::Keyword(format!("")));
    // For loop var is colored as assign-lhs
    chunks.push(Chunk::AssignLhs(format!("{}=", var_name)));
    // But we need to un-do the = ... let me rethink
    // Actually the for variable is colored as assign-lhs WITHOUT the =
    if let Some(Chunk::AssignLhs(ref mut s)) = chunks.last_mut() {
        *s = var_name.clone();
    }
    chunks.push(Chunk::Keyword(" ".to_string()));
    
    collect_whitespace(state, chunks);
    
    // "in" keyword
    if state.rest().starts_with(b"in") && !is_ident_char(state.at(2).unwrap_or(0)) {
        read_keyword_word(state); // consume "in"
        chunks.push(Chunk::Keyword("in".to_string()));
    }
    
    collect_whitespace(state, chunks);
    
    // Parse the items (until ; or do or newline)
    parse_for_items(state, &var_name, chunks);
    
    collect_whitespace(state, chunks);
    // consume optional ;
    if state.peek() == Some(b';') {
        push_verbatim(chunks, ";");
        state.advance();
    }
    collect_whitespace(state, chunks);
    
    if state.rest().starts_with(b"do") && !is_ident_char(state.at(2).unwrap_or(0)) {
        let k = read_keyword_word(state);
        chunks.push(Chunk::Keyword(k));
        collect_whitespace(state, chunks);
    }
    
    let body = parse_statements(state, &["done"]);
    chunks.extend(body);
    collect_whitespace(state, chunks);
    
    if state.rest().starts_with(b"done") && !is_ident_char(state.at(4).unwrap_or(0)) {
        let k = read_keyword_word(state);
        chunks.push(Chunk::Keyword(k));
    }
}

fn read_arith_for(state: &mut State) -> String {
    let start = state.pos;
    assert!(state.starts_with(b"(("));
    state.pos += 2;
    let mut depth = 1u32;
    while state.pos < state.input.len() {
        if state.starts_with(b"((") { depth += 1; state.pos += 2; }
        else if state.starts_with(b"))") { 
            depth -= 1; 
            state.pos += 2;
            if depth == 0 { break; }
        } else {
            state.pos += 1;
        }
    }
    std::str::from_utf8(&state.input[start..state.pos]).unwrap_or("").to_string()
}

fn parse_for_items(state: &mut State, _var: &str, chunks: &mut Vec<Chunk>) {
    // Parse the items in "for var in ITEMS; do"
    // Items can be: plain words, $var, $(), globs, etc.
    // Each unquoted $var should become "${var[@]}"
    // Each unquoted $() should become "$(...)"
    // "$@" stays, "$*" becomes "$@", $@ becomes "$@", $* becomes "$@"
    
    loop {
        collect_inline_whitespace(state, chunks);
        
        if state.pos >= state.input.len() { break; }
        let c = state.input[state.pos];
        
        // Check for terminator
        if c == b';' || c == b'\n' || c == b'\r' { break; }
        if state.rest().starts_with(b"do") && !is_ident_char(state.at(2).unwrap_or(0)) { break; }
        
        // Parse one item
        let item_chunks = parse_for_item(state);
        chunks.extend(item_chunks);
    }
}

fn collect_inline_whitespace(state: &mut State, chunks: &mut Vec<Chunk>) {
    let start = state.pos;
    while state.pos < state.input.len() {
        let c = state.input[state.pos];
        if c == b' ' || c == b'\t' { state.pos += 1; }
        else { break; }
    }
    if state.pos > start {
        push_verbatim(chunks, std::str::from_utf8(&state.input[start..state.pos]).unwrap_or(""));
    }
}

fn parse_for_item(state: &mut State) -> Vec<Chunk> {
    // Parse a single word in the for-in list
    // Returns transformed version
    let mut chunks = Vec::new();
    
    if state.pos >= state.input.len() { return chunks; }
    let c = state.input[state.pos];
    
    match c {
        b'"' => {
            // Already double-quoted
            let dq = parse_double_quote(state);
            chunks.push(dq);
        }
        b'\'' => {
            let sq = parse_single_quote(state);
            chunks.push(sq);
        }
        b'$' => {
            // Could be $var, ${var}, $(), $(())
            // In for-in context: $var -> "${var[@]}"
            // $@ -> "$@", $* -> "$@", $() -> "$(...)"
            let item = parse_for_item_dollar(state);
            chunks.push(item);
        }
        b'`' => {
            // Backtick cmd sub -> "$(...)" 
            let bt = parse_backtick(state);
            // In for-in context, backtick needs quoting
            match bt {
                Chunk::BacktickNeedsQuote { inner } => {
                    // In for-in, we quote it: "$(inner)"
                    // Build a CmdSubNeedsQuote or wrap in quotes
                    chunks.push(Chunk::CmdSubNeedsQuote { open: "$(`.to_string(), inner, close: "`".to_string() });
                }
                other => chunks.push(other),
            }
        }
        _ => {
            // Plain word (glob, literal, etc.)
            let word = read_plain_word(state);
            push_verbatim(&mut chunks, &word);
        }
    }
    
    chunks
}

                    if t != content && exit_code == 0 { exit_code = 0; }
                }
                Err(_) => { exit_code = 1; }
            }
        }
        Mode::Syntax => {
            match process(content, filename) {
                Ok(chunks) => { let _ = out.write_all(render_syntax(&chunks).as_bytes()); }
                Err(_) => { exit_code = 1; }
            }
        }

                Ok(chunks) => {
                    let _ = out.write_all(render_suggest(&chunks).as_bytes());
                    let t = render_transform(&chunks);
                    if t != content && exit_code == 0 { exit_code = 0; }

            }
        }
        Mode::SyntaxSuggest => {
            match process(content, filename) {
                Ok(chunks) => {

                    if t != content && exit_code == 0 { exit_code = 0; }

        }

            }
        }
    }
    exit_code
}

// A "chunk" represents a parsed piece of the script with semantic information
#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
enum Chunk {
    Verbatim(String),
    Comment(String),
    Keyword(String),
    Command(String),
    AssignLhs(String),       // "varname=" 
    // Unsafe variable: original text, transformed text
    UnsafeVar { orig: String, trans: String },
    // Safe variable (no quoting needed: $? $$ $! $#)
    SafeVar(String),
    // Double-quoted string with its parts
    DoubleQuote(Vec<DQChunk>),
    // Single-quoted string
    SingleQuote(String),
    // Arithmetic expansion $((...)) - safe
    Arithmetic(String),
    // Heredoc content (entire thing from << to closing delimiter)
    Heredoc(String),
    // Command substitution $(...) that needs quoting in its context
    // contains: open text, inner chunks, close text
    CmdSubNeedsQuote { open: String, inner: Vec<Chunk>, close: String },
    // Command substitution that is already in a quoted context
    CmdSubInQuote { open: String, inner: Vec<Chunk>, close: String },
    // Backtick substitution needing quoting
    BacktickNeedsQuote { inner: Vec<Chunk> },
    // Process substitution <(...) or >(...)
    ProcSub { open: String, inner: Vec<Chunk>, close: String },
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
enum DQChunk {
    Literal(String),
    // Variable: original text, whether braces can be removed
    Var { orig: String, remove_braces: bool },
    // Command substitution inside double quotes
    CmdSub { open: String, inner: Vec<Chunk>, close: String },
    // Arithmetic inside double quotes
    Arithmetic(String),
}

// Render functions
fn render_transform(chunks: &[Chunk]) -> String {
    let mut out = String::new();
    for chunk in chunks {
        render_transform_chunk(chunk, &mut out);
    }
    out
}

fn render_transform_chunk(chunk: &Chunk, out: &mut String) {
    match chunk {
        Chunk::Verbatim(s) => out.push_str(s),
        Chunk::Comment(s) => out.push_str(s),
        Chunk::Keyword(s) => out.push_str(s),
        Chunk::Command(s) => out.push_str(s),
        Chunk::AssignLhs(s) => out.push_str(s),
        Chunk::UnsafeVar { trans, .. } => out.push_str(trans),
        Chunk::SafeVar(s) => out.push_str(s),
        Chunk::DoubleQuote(parts) => {
            out.push('"');
            for part in parts {
                match part {
                    DQChunk::Literal(s) => out.push_str(s),
                    DQChunk::Var { orig, remove_braces } => {
                        if *remove_braces {
                            // Remove braces: "${var}" -> "$var"
                            // orig is like "${var}", transform to "$var"
                            let inner = strip_braces_from_var(orig);
                            out.push_str(&inner);
                        } else {
                            out.push_str(orig);
                        }
                    }
                    DQChunk::CmdSub { open, inner, close } => {
                        out.push_str(open);
                        for c in inner { render_transform_chunk(c, out); }
                        out.push_str(close);
                    }
                    DQChunk::Arithmetic(s) => out.push_str(s),
                }
            }
            out.push('"');
        }
        Chunk::SingleQuote(s) => out.push_str(s),
        Chunk::Arithmetic(s) => out.push_str(s),
        Chunk::Heredoc(s) => out.push_str(s),
        Chunk::CmdSubNeedsQuote { open, inner, close } => {
            out.push('"');
            out.push_str(open);
            for c in inner { render_transform_chunk(c, out); }
            out.push_str(close);
            out.push('"');
        }
        Chunk::CmdSubInQuote { open, inner, close } => {
            out.push_str(open);
            for c in inner { render_transform_chunk(c, out); }
            out.push_str(close);
        }
        Chunk::BacktickNeedsQuote { inner } => {
            // Convert `cmd $var` to "$(cmd "$var")"
            out.push_str("\"$(");
            for c in inner { render_transform_chunk(c, out); }
            out.push_str(")\"");
        }
        Chunk::ProcSub { open, inner, close } => {
            out.push_str(open);
            for c in inner { render_transform_chunk(c, out); }
            out.push_str(close);
        }
    }
}

fn strip_braces_from_var(orig: &str) -> String {
    // "${var}" -> "$var"  OR  "${var[@]}" -> stays
    // orig starts with $ { name }
    let bytes = orig.as_bytes();
    if bytes.len() < 4 || bytes[0] != b'$' || bytes[1] != b'{' {
        return orig.to_string();
    }
    let inner = &orig[2..orig.len()-1]; // strip ${ and }
    // Only remove braces if inner is a simple identifier
    if inner.bytes().all(|c| c.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || c == b'_') 
        && inner.len() > 0 
        && (inner.as_bytes()[0].is_ascii_alphabetic() || inner.as_bytes()[0] == b'_') {
        format!("${}", inner)
    } else {
        orig.to_string()
    }
}

}

fn render_suggest(chunks: &[Chunk]) -> String {
    let mut out = String::new();
    for chunk in chunks {
        render_suggest_chunk(chunk, &mut out);

                        }

        Chunk::Arithmetic(s) => out.push_str(s),

        Chunk::CmdSubNeedsQuote { open, inner, close } => {

            out.push_str(COLOR_RESET);

            out.push_str(close);

            out.push('"');
            out.push_str(COLOR_RESET);
        }
        Chunk::CmdSubInQuote { open, inner, close } => {
            out.push_str(open);
