fn get_var_inner(orig: &str) -> &str {
    // "${var}" -> "var"
    if orig.starts_with("${") && orig.ends_with('}') {
        &orig[2..orig.len()-1]
    } else {
        &orig[1..] // "$var" -> "var"
    }
}

fn render_suggest_uvar(orig: &str, trans: &str, out: &mut String) {
    // orig is the original text, trans is the transformed version
    // We need to show what changes are being made with colored markers
    
    // Parse trans to understand the structure
    // trans could be:
    // "$var" -> orig was "$var" (just add quotes), show: GREEN(")orig GREEN(")
    // "${var}" -> orig was "${var}" add quotes
    // "${var[@]}" -> orig was "$var" (add braces, @, and quotes)
    // "$var$other" -> orig was "$var$other" (just add quotes)
    
    // Simple approach: compare orig and trans
    // The trans is always "..." some content "..."
    // The opening and closing quotes are added
    // Inside, some braces may be added/changed
    
    // For now: show what's suggested with green background for additions
    // This is the suggest mode showing the diff
    
    // Strategy: if trans == "\"" + orig + "\"", just show GREEN(") orig GREEN(")
    // Otherwise, need more detailed diff
    
    let trans_inner = if trans.starts_with('"') && trans.ends_with('"') {
        &trans[1..trans.len()-1]
    } else {
        trans
    };
    
    // Case: trans is a simple quoting of orig
    if trans_inner == orig {
        out.push_str(COLOR_SUGGEST_ADD);
        out.push('"');
        out.push_str(COLOR_RESET);
        out.push_str(orig);
        out.push_str(COLOR_SUGGEST_ADD);
        out.push('"');
        out.push_str(COLOR_RESET);
        return;
    }
    
    // More complex: the content changed too
    // We need to show a diff between orig and trans_inner
    // For example: $var -> "${var[@]}" 
    //   orig = "$var", trans_inner = "${var[@]}"
    //   show: GREEN(")$GREEN({)varGREEN([@])")GREEN(")
    
    // For now, just show the whole thing as a suggestion
    // Show what gets added (green) and what stays the same
    render_var_diff(orig, trans_inner, trans, out);
}

fn render_var_diff(orig: &str, trans_inner: &str, _trans: &str, out: &mut String) {
    // Determine what changed
    // Common patterns:
    // 1. Just add quotes: orig == trans_inner -> GREEN(")orig GREEN(")
    // 2. $var -> "${var[@]}": add ", {, [@]} 
    // 3. ${var} -> remove braces (handled in DQ context)
    // 4. $* -> "$@": change * to @
    // 5. Multiple vars: $a$b -> "$a$b" (no structural change, just quotes)
    
    // Let's do a simple character-by-character diff
    // For the case orig == trans_inner:
    if orig == trans_inner {
        out.push_str(COLOR_SUGGEST_ADD);
        out.push('"');
        out.push_str(COLOR_RESET);
        out.push_str(orig);
        out.push_str(COLOR_SUGGEST_ADD);
        out.push('"');
        out.push_str(COLOR_RESET);
        return;
    }
    
    // For $var -> "${var[@]}": orig is "$var", trans_inner is "${var[@]}"
    // For $* -> "$@": orig is "$*", trans_inner is "$@"
    // For $arr -> "${arr[@]}": orig is "$arr", trans_inner is "${arr[@]}"
    
    // Find common prefix and suffix
    let orig_bytes = orig.as_bytes();
    let trans_bytes = trans_inner.as_bytes();
    
    let mut prefix_len = 0;
    while prefix_len < orig_bytes.len() && prefix_len < trans_bytes.len() 
        && orig_bytes[prefix_len] == trans_bytes[prefix_len] {
        prefix_len += 1;
    }
    
    let mut orig_suffix = orig_bytes.len();
    let mut trans_suffix = trans_bytes.len();
    while orig_suffix > prefix_len && trans_suffix > prefix_len 
        && orig_bytes[orig_suffix-1] == trans_bytes[trans_suffix-1] {
        orig_suffix -= 1;
        trans_suffix -= 1;
    }
    
    // prefix: orig[0..prefix_len] == trans[0..prefix_len]  (keep)
    // middle: orig[prefix_len..orig_suffix] removed, trans[prefix_len..trans_suffix] added
    // suffix: orig[orig_suffix..] == trans[trans_suffix..]  (keep)
    
    out.push_str(COLOR_SUGGEST_ADD);
    out.push('"');
    out.push_str(COLOR_RESET);
    
    let prefix = std::str::from_utf8(&orig_bytes[..prefix_len]).unwrap_or("");
    let orig_mid = std::str::from_utf8(&orig_bytes[prefix_len..orig_suffix]).unwrap_or("");
    let trans_mid = std::str::from_utf8(&trans_bytes[prefix_len..trans_suffix]).unwrap_or("");
    let suffix = std::str::from_utf8(&orig_bytes[orig_suffix..]).unwrap_or("");
    
    out.push_str(prefix);
    if !orig_mid.is_empty() {
        out.push_str(COLOR_SUGGEST_REMOVE);
        out.push_str(orig_mid);
        out.push_str(COLOR_RESET);
    }
    if !trans_mid.is_empty() {
        out.push_str(COLOR_SUGGEST_ADD);
        out.push_str(trans_mid);
        out.push_str(COLOR_RESET);
    }
    out.push_str(suffix);
    
    out.push_str(COLOR_SUGGEST_ADD);
    out.push('"');
    out.push_str(COLOR_RESET);
}

fn render_syntax_suggest(chunks: &[Chunk]) -> String {
    let mut out = String::new();
    for chunk in chunks {
        render_ss_chunk(chunk, &mut out);
    }
    out
}

fn render_ss_chunk(chunk: &Chunk, out: &mut String) {
    match chunk {
        Chunk::Verbatim(s) => out.push_str(s),
        Chunk::Comment(s) => {
            out.push_str(COLOR_COMMENT);
            out.push_str(s);
            out.push_str(COLOR_RESET);
        }
        Chunk::Keyword(s) => {
            out.push_str(COLOR_KEYWORD);
            out.push_str(s);
            out.push_str(COLOR_RESET);
        }
        Chunk::Command(s) => {
            out.push_str(COLOR_COMMAND);
            out.push_str(s);
            out.push_str(COLOR_RESET);
        }
        Chunk::AssignLhs(s) => {
            let eq_pos = s.rfind('=').unwrap_or(s.len());
            out.push_str(COLOR_ASSIGN_LHS);
            out.push_str(&s[..eq_pos]);
            out.push_str(COLOR_RESET);
            out.push_str(&s[eq_pos..]);
        }
        Chunk::UnsafeVar { orig, trans } => {
            // Show suggestion with syntax coloring
            render_ss_uvar(orig, trans, out);
        }
        Chunk::SafeVar(s) => {
            out.push_str(COLOR_VARIABLE);
            out.push_str(s);
            out.push_str(COLOR_RESET);
        }
        Chunk::DoubleQuote(parts) => {
            out.push_str(COLOR_DOUBLE_QUOTE);
            out.push('"');
            for part in parts {
                match part {
                    DQChunk::Literal(s) => out.push_str(s),
                    DQChunk::Var { orig, remove_braces } => {
                        if *remove_braces {
                            let inner = get_var_inner(orig);
                            out.push_str(COLOR_VARIABLE);
                            out.push('$');
                            out.push_str(COLOR_SUGGEST_REMOVE);
                            out.push('{');
                            out.push_str(COLOR_VARIABLE);
                            out.push_str(inner);
                            out.push_str(COLOR_SUGGEST_REMOVE);
                            out.push('}');
                            out.push_str(COLOR_DOUBLE_QUOTE);
                        } else {
                            out.push_str(COLOR_VARIABLE);
                            out.push_str(orig);
                            out.push_str(COLOR_DOUBLE_QUOTE);
                        }
                    }
                    DQChunk::CmdSub { open, inner, close } => {
                        out.push_str(COLOR_RESET);
                        out.push_str(open);
                        for c in inner { render_ss_chunk(c, out); }
                        out.push_str(close);
                        out.push_str(COLOR_DOUBLE_QUOTE);
                    }
                    DQChunk::Arithmetic(s) => out.push_str(s),
                }
            }
            out.push('"');
            out.push_str(COLOR_RESET);
        }
        Chunk::SingleQuote(s) => {
            out.push_str(COLOR_SINGLE_QUOTE);
            out.push_str(s);
            out.push_str(COLOR_RESET);
        }
        Chunk::Arithmetic(s) => {
            out.push_str(COLOR_ARITHMETIC);
            out.push_str(s);
            out.push_str(COLOR_RESET);
        }
        Chunk::Heredoc(s) => {
            out.push_str(COLOR_HEREDOC);
            out.push_str(s);
            out.push_str(COLOR_RESET);
        }
        Chunk::CmdSubNeedsQuote { open, inner, close } => {
            out.push_str(COLOR_SUGGEST_ADD);
            out.push('"');
            out.push_str(COLOR_RESET);
            out.push_str(open);
            for c in inner { render_ss_chunk(c, out); }
            out.push_str(close);
            out.push_str(COLOR_SUGGEST_ADD);
            out.push('"');
            out.push_str(COLOR_RESET);
        }
        Chunk::CmdSubInQuote { open, inner, close } => {
            out.push_str(open);
            for c in inner { render_ss_chunk(c, out); }
            out.push_str(close);
        }
        Chunk::BacktickNeedsQuote { inner } => {
            out.push_str(COLOR_SUGGEST_ADD);
            out.push_str("\"$(");
            out.push_str(COLOR_RESET);
            out.push('`');
            for c in inner { render_ss_chunk(c, out); }
            out.push('`');
            out.push_str(COLOR_SUGGEST_ADD);
            out.push_str(")\"");
            out.push_str(COLOR_RESET);
        }
        Chunk::ProcSub { open, inner, close } => {
            out.push_str(open);
            for c in inner { render_ss_chunk(c, out); }
            out.push_str(close);
        }
    }
}

fn render_ss_uvar(orig: &str, trans: &str, out: &mut String) {
    let trans_inner = if trans.starts_with('"') && trans.ends_with('"') {
        &trans[1..trans.len()-1]
    } else {
        trans
    };
    
    // Case: trans is a simple quoting of orig (no structural change)
    if trans_inner == orig {
        out.push_str(COLOR_SUGGEST_ADD);
        out.push('"');
        out.push_str(COLOR_VARIABLE);
        out.push_str(orig);
        out.push_str(COLOR_SUGGEST_ADD);
        out.push('"');
        out.push_str(COLOR_RESET);
        return;
    }
    
    // More complex diff
    let orig_bytes = orig.as_bytes();
    let trans_bytes = trans_inner.as_bytes();
    
    let mut prefix_len = 0;
    while prefix_len < orig_bytes.len() && prefix_len < trans_bytes.len() 
        && orig_bytes[prefix_len] == trans_bytes[prefix_len] {
        prefix_len += 1;
    }
    let mut orig_suffix = orig_bytes.len();
    let mut trans_suffix = trans_bytes.len();
    while orig_suffix > prefix_len && trans_suffix > prefix_len 
        && orig_bytes[orig_suffix-1] == trans_bytes[trans_suffix-1] {
        orig_suffix -= 1;
        trans_suffix -= 1;
    }
    
    out.push_str(COLOR_SUGGEST_ADD);
    out.push('"');
    out.push_str(COLOR_VARIABLE);
    
    let prefix = std::str::from_utf8(&orig_bytes[..prefix_len]).unwrap_or("");
    let orig_mid = std::str::from_utf8(&orig_bytes[prefix_len..orig_suffix]).unwrap_or("");
    let trans_mid = std::str::from_utf8(&trans_bytes[prefix_len..trans_suffix]).unwrap_or("");
    let suffix = std::str::from_utf8(&orig_bytes[orig_suffix..]).unwrap_or("");
    
    out.push_str(prefix);
    if !orig_mid.is_empty() {
        out.push_str(COLOR_SUGGEST_REMOVE);
        out.push_str(orig_mid);
        out.push_str(COLOR_VARIABLE);
    }
    if !trans_mid.is_empty() {
        out.push_str(COLOR_SUGGEST_ADD);
        out.push_str(trans_mid);
        out.push_str(COLOR_VARIABLE);
    }
    out.push_str(suffix);
    
    out.push_str(COLOR_SUGGEST_ADD);
    out.push('"');
    out.push_str(COLOR_RESET);
}

// ================================================================
// The Parser
// ================================================================

struct State<'a> {
    input: &'a [u8],
    pos: usize,
    filename: Option<&'a str>,
    error: bool,
}

impl<'a> State<'a> {
    fn new(input: &'a [u8], filename: Option<&'a str>) -> Self {
        State { input, pos: 0, filename, error: false }
    }
    fn peek(&self) -> Option<u8> { self.input.get(self.pos).copied() }
    fn peek2(&self) -> Option<u8> { self.input.get(self.pos+1).copied() }
    fn peek3(&self) -> Option<u8> { self.input.get(self.pos+2).copied() }
    fn advance(&mut self) -> Option<u8> {
        let c = self.input.get(self.pos).copied();
        if c.is_some() { self.pos += 1; }
        c
    }
    fn at(&self, offset: usize) -> Option<u8> { self.input.get(self.pos + offset).copied() }
    fn starts_with(&self, s: &[u8]) -> bool {
        self.input[self.pos..].starts_with(s)
    }
    fn rest(&self) -> &[u8] { &self.input[self.pos..] }
}

fn process(content: &str, filename: Option<&str>) -> Result<Vec<Chunk>, ()> {
    let mut state = State::new(content.as_bytes(), filename);
    let chunks = parse_script(&mut state);
    if state.error { Err(()) } else { Ok(chunks) }
}

// Context for parsing
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq)]
enum Context {
    Normal,
    InDoubleQuote,
    InCmdSub(u32),      // nesting depth
    InArithmetic(u32),
    InForIn,
    InCase,
    InDoubleBracket,
    AssignRhs,          // right-hand side of an assignment
    AssignKeyword,      // argument to export/local/declare/readonly
}

fn parse_script(state: &mut State) -> Vec<Chunk> {
    parse_statements(state, &[])
}

// Parse statements until we hit one of the stop strings
fn parse_statements(state: &mut State, stop_tokens: &[&str]) -> Vec<Chunk> {
    let mut chunks: Vec<Chunk> = Vec::new();
    
    loop {
        // Skip whitespace and newlines, collecting them as verbatim
        collect_whitespace(state, &mut chunks);
        
        if state.pos >= state.input.len() {
            break;
        }
        
        // Check for stop tokens
        let mut stopped = false;
        for stop in stop_tokens {
            let sbytes = stop.as_bytes();
            if state.rest().starts_with(sbytes) {
                // Check it's not part of a longer word
                let after = state.pos + sbytes.len();
                let next_char = state.input.get(after).copied();
                let is_word_end = next_char.map(|c| !is_ident_char(c) || *stop == "}" || *stop == ")" || *stop == "esac" || *stop == "fi" || *stop == "done" || *stop == "then" || *stop == "else" || *stop == "elif" || *stop == "do" || *stop == "in" || *stop == ";;").unwrap_or(true);
                if is_word_end || stop_is_punct(stop) {
                    stopped = true;
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
        if stopped { break; }
        
        // Parse a statement (a pipeline or command list)
        if let Some(stmt_chunks) = parse_one_statement(state, stop_tokens) {
            chunks.extend(stmt_chunks);
        } else {
            break;
        }
    }
    
    chunks
}

fn stop_is_punct(s: &str) -> bool {
    matches!(s, "}" | ")" | "]" | ";;" | ";;;" | ";&" | ";;&")
}

fn collect_whitespace(state: &mut State, chunks: &mut Vec<Chunk>) {
    let start = state.pos;
    while state.pos < state.input.len() {
        let c = state.input[state.pos];
        if c == b' ' || c == b'\t' || c == b'\n' || c == b'\r' {
            state.pos += 1;
        } else if c == b'\\' && state.input.get(state.pos+1) == Some(&b'\n') {
            // Line continuation
            state.pos += 2;
        } else {
            break;
        }
    }
    if state.pos > start {
        let text = std::str::from_utf8(&state.input[start..state.pos]).unwrap_or("").to_string();
        if !text.is_empty() {
            push_verbatim(chunks, &text);
        }
    }
}

fn push_verbatim(chunks: &mut Vec<Chunk>, s: &str) {
    if s.is_empty() { return; }
    if let Some(Chunk::Verbatim(ref mut prev)) = chunks.last_mut() {
        prev.push_str(s);
    } else {
        chunks.push(Chunk::Verbatim(s.to_string()));
    }
}

fn is_ident_char(c: u8) -> bool { c.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || c == b'_' }
fn is_ident_start(c: u8) -> bool { c.is_ascii_alphabetic() || c == b'_' }

fn parse_one_statement(state: &mut State, stop_tokens: &[&str]) -> Option<Vec<Chunk>> {
    let mut chunks: Vec<Chunk> = Vec::new();
    
    if state.pos >= state.input.len() { return None; }
    let c = state.input[state.pos];
    
    // Handle comments
    if c == b'#' {
        let comment = read_comment(state);
        chunks.push(Chunk::Comment(comment));
        return Some(chunks);
    }
    
    // Handle compound commands
    // if/then/fi, while/do/done, for/do/done, case/esac, {}, ()
    if let Some(kw_chunks) = try_parse_compound(state, stop_tokens) {
        return Some(kw_chunks);
    }
    
    // Parse a simple command (assignments + command + args)
    parse_simple_command(state, &mut chunks, stop_tokens);
    
    // After a command, parse any && || | ; & etc.
    collect_separators(state, &mut chunks, stop_tokens);
    
    if chunks.is_empty() { None } else { Some(chunks) }
}

fn read_comment(state: &mut State) -> String {
    let start = state.pos;
    while state.pos < state.input.len() && state.input[state.pos] != b'\n' {
        state.pos += 1;
    }
    std::str::from_utf8(&state.input[start..state.pos]).unwrap_or("").to_string()
}

fn try_parse_compound(state: &mut State, stop_tokens: &[&str]) -> Option<Vec<Chunk>> {
    let mut chunks: Vec<Chunk> = Vec::new();
    
    // Peek at the next word
    let word = peek_word(state);
    
    match word.as_str() {
        "if" => {
            parse_if_block(state, &mut chunks);
            return Some(chunks);
        }
        "while" | "until" => {
            parse_while_block(state, &mut chunks);
            return Some(chunks);
        }
        "for" => {
            parse_for_block(state, &mut chunks);
            return Some(chunks);
        }
        "select" => {
            parse_select_block(state, &mut chunks);
            return Some(chunks);
        }
        "case" => {
            parse_case_block(state, &mut chunks);
            return Some(chunks);
        }
        "{" => {
            parse_brace_group(state, &mut chunks);
            return Some(chunks);
        }
        "(" => {
            parse_subshell(state, &mut chunks);
            return Some(chunks);
        }
        "function" => {
            parse_function(state, &mut chunks);
            return Some(chunks);
        }
        _ => {}
    }
    
    // Check for function definition: name() { ... }
    if looks_like_function_def(state) {
        parse_function_def(state, &mut chunks);
        return Some(chunks);
    }
    
    None
}

fn peek_word(state: &State) -> String {
    let mut i = state.pos;
    let mut word = String::new();
    while i < state.input.len() {
        let c = state.input[i];
        if c.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || c == b'_' || c == b'{' || c == b'(' {
            if word.is_empty() || !matches!(c, b'{' | b'(') {
                word.push(c as char);
            } else {
                break;
            }
        } else {
            break;
        }
        i += 1;
        if word == "{" || word == "(" { break; }
    }
    word
}

fn looks_like_function_def(state: &State) -> bool {
    // Check for pattern: identifier() or identifier ()
    let mut i = state.pos;
    // Skip identifier
    if i >= state.input.len() { return false; }
    if !is_ident_start(state.input[i]) { return false; }
    while i < state.input.len() && is_ident_char(state.input[i]) { i += 1; }
    // Skip spaces
    while i < state.input.len() && state.input[i] == b' ' { i += 1; }
    // Check for (
    if i >= state.input.len() || state.input[i] != b'(' { return false; }
    i += 1;
    // Skip spaces
    while i < state.input.len() && state.input[i] == b' ' { i += 1; }
    // Check for )
    if i >= state.input.len() || state.input[i] != b')' { return false; }
    true
}

fn read_keyword_word(state: &mut State) -> String {
    let start = state.pos;
    while state.pos < state.input.len() {
        let c = state.input[state.pos];
        if c.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || c == b'_' {
            state.pos += 1;
        } else {
            break;
        }
    }
    std::str::from_utf8(&state.input[start..state.pos]).unwrap_or("").to_string()
}

fn parse_if_block(state: &mut State, chunks: &mut Vec<Chunk>) {
    // if condition; then body [elif condition; then body]* [else body] fi
    let kw = read_keyword_word(state);
    chunks.push(Chunk::Keyword(kw + " "));
    collect_whitespace(state, chunks);
    
    // condition
    parse_condition_body(state, chunks, &["then"]);
    
    // then
    if state.rest().starts_with(b"then") {
        let kw = read_keyword_word(state);
        chunks.push(Chunk::Keyword(kw));
        collect_whitespace(state, chunks);
    }
    
    // body until elif/else/fi
    let body = parse_statements(state, &["elif", "else", "fi"]);
    chunks.extend(body);
    
    loop {
        collect_whitespace(state, chunks);
        if state.rest().starts_with(b"elif") {
            let kw = read_keyword_word(state); // "elif"
            // Check next char
            let nc = state.peek().unwrap_or(0);
            if nc == b' ' || nc == b'\t' || nc == b'\n' {
                chunks.push(Chunk::Keyword(kw + " "));
                collect_whitespace(state, chunks);
                parse_condition_body(state, chunks, &["then"]);
                if state.rest().starts_with(b"then") {
                    let k = read_keyword_word(state);
                    chunks.push(Chunk::Keyword(k));
                    collect_whitespace(state, chunks);
                }
                let body = parse_statements(state, &["elif", "else", "fi"]);
                chunks.extend(body);
            } else {
                // Not actually "elif" keyword
                push_verbatim(chunks, &kw);
                break;
            }
        } else if state.rest().starts_with(b"else") {
            let nc = state.at(4).unwrap_or(0);
            if !is_ident_char(nc) {
                let kw = read_keyword_word(state);
                chunks.push(Chunk::Keyword(kw));
                collect_whitespace(state, chunks);
                let body = parse_statements(state, &["fi"]);
                chunks.extend(body);
                collect_whitespace(state, chunks);
                if state.rest().starts_with(b"fi") {
                    let nc2 = state.at(2).unwrap_or(0);
                    if !is_ident_char(nc2) {
                        let k = read_keyword_word(state);
                        chunks.push(Chunk::Keyword(k));
                    }
                }
                break;
            } else {
                break;
            }
        } else if state.rest().starts_with(b"fi") {
            let nc = state.at(2).unwrap_or(0);
            if !is_ident_char(nc) {
                let k = read_keyword_word(state);
                chunks.push(Chunk::Keyword(k));
                break;
            } else {
                break;
            }
        } else {
            break;
        }
    }
}

fn parse_condition_body(state: &mut State, chunks: &mut Vec<Chunk>, stop: &[&str]) {
    let body = parse_statements(state, stop);
    chunks.extend(body);
}

fn parse_while_block(state: &mut State, chunks: &mut Vec<Chunk>) {
    let kw = read_keyword_word(state); // "while" or "until"
    chunks.push(Chunk::Keyword(kw + " "));
    collect_whitespace(state, chunks);
    
    let cond = parse_statements(state, &["do"]);
    chunks.extend(cond);
    collect_whitespace(state, chunks);
    
    if state.rest().starts_with(b"do") && !is_ident_char(state.at(2).unwrap_or(0)) {
        let k = read_keyword_word(state);
        chunks.push(Chunk::Keyword(k));
        collect_whitespace(state, chunks);
    }
    
    let body = parse_statements(state, &["done"]);
    chunks.extend(body);
    collect_whitespace(state, chunks);
    
    if state.rest().starts_with(b"done") && !is_ident_char(state.at(4).unwrap_or(0)) {
        let k = read_keyword_word(state);
        chunks.push(Chunk::Keyword(k));
    }
}

fn parse_for_block(state: &mut State, chunks: &mut Vec<Chunk>) {
    // for var in items; do body done
    // for (( init; cond; step )); do body done
    let kw = read_keyword_word(state); // "for"
    
    // Check if it's C-style for loop
    // Skip whitespace
    let saved_pos = state.pos;
    while state.pos < state.input.len() && (state.input[state.pos] == b' ' || state.input[state.pos] == b'\t') {
        state.pos += 1;
    }
    let ws1 = std::str::from_utf8(&state.input[saved_pos..state.pos]).unwrap_or("").to_string();
    
    if state.starts_with(b"((") {
        // C-style for loop: for ((init; cond; step))
        chunks.push(Chunk::Keyword(kw));
        push_verbatim(chunks, &ws1);
        // Parse the (( )) arithmetic
        let arith = read_arith_for(state);
        chunks.push(Chunk::Arithmetic(arith));
        collect_whitespace(state, chunks);
        // Parse ; do body done
        collect_separators_basic(state, chunks);
        collect_whitespace(state, chunks);
        if state.rest().starts_with(b"do") && !is_ident_char(state.at(2).unwrap_or(0)) {
            let k = read_keyword_word(state);
            chunks.push(Chunk::Keyword(k));
            collect_whitespace(state, chunks);
        }
        let body = parse_statements(state, &["done"]);
        chunks.extend(body);
        collect_whitespace(state, chunks);
        if state.rest().starts_with(b"done") && !is_ident_char(state.at(4).unwrap_or(0)) {
            let k = read_keyword_word(state);
            chunks.push(Chunk::Keyword(k));
        }
        return;
    }
    
    // Regular for loop
    chunks.push(Chunk::Keyword(kw + " "));
    push_verbatim(chunks, &ws1.trim_start().to_string());
    collect_whitespace(state, chunks);
    
    // Read the loop variable name
    let var_start = state.pos;
    while state.pos < state.input.len() && is_ident_char(state.input[state.pos]) {
        state.pos += 1;
    }
    let var_name = std::str::from_utf8(&state.input[var_start..state.pos]).unwrap_or("").to_string();
    chunks.push(Chunk::Keyword(format!("")));
    // For loop var is colored as assign-lhs
    chunks.push(Chunk::AssignLhs(format!("{}=", var_name)));
    // But we need to un-do the = ... let me rethink

    if let Some(Chunk::AssignLhs(ref mut s)) = chunks.last_mut() {

    }
    chunks.push(Chunk::Keyword(" ".to_string()));
    
    collect_whitespace(state, chunks);

    if state.rest().starts_with(b"in") && !is_ident_char(state.at(2).unwrap_or(0)) {
        read_keyword_word(state); // consume "in"
        chunks.push(Chunk::Keyword("in".to_string()));
    }
    
    collect_whitespace(state, chunks);
    
    // Parse the items (until ; or do or newline)
    parse_for_items(state, &var_name, chunks);
    
    collect_whitespace(state, chunks);
    // consume optional ;
    if state.peek() == Some(b';') {
        push_verbatim(chunks, ";");
        state.advance();

    collect_whitespace(state, chunks);

        chunks.push(Chunk::Keyword(k));
        collect_whitespace(state, chunks);

    chunks.extend(body);
    collect_whitespace(state, chunks);
    
    if state.rest().starts_with(b"done") && !is_ident_char(state.at(4).unwrap_or(0)) {
        let k = read_keyword_word(state);
        chunks.push(Chunk::Keyword(k));
    }
}

fn read_arith_for(state: &mut State) -> String {
    let start = state.pos;
    assert!(state.starts_with(b"(("));
    state.pos += 2;
    let mut depth = 1u32;
    while state.pos < state.input.len() {
        if state.starts_with(b"((") { depth += 1; state.pos += 2; }
        else if state.starts_with(b"))") { 
            depth -= 1; 
            state.pos += 2;
            if depth == 0 { break; }
        } else {
            state.pos += 1;
        }
    }
    std::str::from_utf8(&state.input[start..state.pos]).unwrap_or("").to_string()
}

fn parse_for_items(state: &mut State, _var: &str, chunks: &mut Vec<Chunk>) {
    // Parse the items in "for var in ITEMS; do"
    // Items can be: plain words, $var, $(), globs, etc.
    // Each unquoted $var should become "${var[@]}"
    // Each unquoted $() should become "$(...)"
    // "$@" stays, "$*" becomes "$@", $@ becomes "$@", $* becomes "$@"
    
    loop {
        collect_inline_whitespace(state, chunks);
        
        if state.pos >= state.input.len() { break; }
        let c = state.input[state.pos];
        
        // Check for terminator
        if c == b';' || c == b'\n' || c == b'\r' { break; }
        if state.rest().starts_with(b"do") && !is_ident_char(state.at(2).unwrap_or(0)) { break; }
        
        // Parse one item
        let item_chunks = parse_for_item(state);
        chunks.extend(item_chunks);
    }
}

fn collect_inline_whitespace(state: &mut State, chunks: &mut Vec<Chunk>) {
    let start = state.pos;
    while state.pos < state.input.len() {
        let c = state.input[state.pos];
        if c == b' ' || c == b'\t' { state.pos += 1; }
        else { break; }
    }
    if state.pos > start {
        push_verbatim(chunks, std::str::from_utf8(&state.input[start..state.pos]).unwrap_or(""));
    }
}

fn parse_for_item(state: &mut State) -> Vec<Chunk> {
    // Parse a single word in the for-in list
    // Returns transformed version
    let mut chunks = Vec::new();
    
    if state.pos >= state.input.len() { return chunks; }
    let c = state.input[state.pos];
    
    match c {
        b'"' => {
            // Already double-quoted
            let dq = parse_double_quote(state);
            chunks.push(dq);
        }
        b'\'' => {
            let sq = parse_single_quote(state);
            chunks.push(sq);
        }
        b'$' => {
            // Could be $var, ${var}, $(), $(())
            // In for-in context: $var -> "${var[@]}"
            // $@ -> "$@", $* -> "$@", $() -> "$(...)"
            let item = parse_for_item_dollar(state);
            chunks.push(item);
        }
        b'`' => {
            // Backtick cmd sub -> "$(...)" 
            let bt = parse_backtick(state);
            // In for-in context, backtick needs quoting
            match bt {
                Chunk::BacktickNeedsQuote { inner } => {
                    // In for-in, we quote it: "$(inner)"
                    // Build a CmdSubNeedsQuote or wrap in quotes
                    chunks.push(Chunk::CmdSubNeedsQuote { open: "$(`.to_string(), inner, close: "`".to_string() });
                }
                other => chunks.push(other),
            }
        }
        _ => {
            // Plain word (glob, literal, etc.)
            let word = read_plain_word(state);
            push_verbatim(&mut chunks, &word);
        }
    }
    
    chunks
}

    let content_start = t.pos;
    loop {
        if t.pos >= t.input.len() { break; }
        let line_start = t.pos;
        if strip {
            while t.pos < t.input.len() && t.input[t.pos] == b'\t' { t.pos += 1; }
        }
        if t.input[t.pos..].starts_with(raw_delim.as_bytes()) {
            let after = t.pos + raw_delim.len();
            if after >= t.input.len() || t.input[after] == b'\n' {
                let content = std::str::from_utf8(&t.input[content_start..line_start]).unwrap_or("").to_string();
                let close_start = t.pos;
                t.pos += raw_delim.len();
                if t.peek() == Some(b'\n') { t.pos += 1; }
                let close = std::str::from_utf8(&t.input[close_start..t.pos]).unwrap_or("").to_string();
                let full = format!("{}{}\n{}{}", op_str, delim_str, content, close);
                t.emit(TKind::Heredoc, &full);
                return;
            }
        }
        t.pos = line_start;
        while t.pos < t.input.len() && t.input[t.pos] != b'\n' { t.pos += 1; }
        if t.pos < t.input.len() { t.pos += 1; }
    }
    
    let remaining = std::str::from_utf8(&t.input[content_start..t.pos]).unwrap_or("").to_string();
    let full = format!("{}{}\n{}", op_str, delim_str, remaining);
    t.emit(TKind::Heredoc, &full);
}

fn skip_blanks_no_emit(t: &mut Tokenizer) {
    while t.pos < t.input.len() && (t.input[t.pos] == b' ' || t.input[t.pos] == b'\t') { t.pos += 1; }
}

fn parse_assign_rhs(t: &mut Tokenizer) {
    // Assignment RHS - $var is safe, but $() needs parsing
    if t.pos >= t.input.len() { return; }
    
    // Array assignment?
    if t.peek() == Some(b'(') {
        t.emit(TKind::Verbatim, "("); t.pos += 1;
        loop {
            skip_blanks(t);
            if t.pos >= t.input.len() { break; }
            let c = t.input[t.pos];
            if c == b'\n' { t.emit(TKind::Verbatim, "\n"); t.pos += 1; continue; }
            if c == b')' { t.emit(TKind::Verbatim, ")"); t.pos += 1; break; }
            parse_arg(t, false, &[b'\n', b')'], &[]);
        }
        return;
    }
    
    // Regular value - parse until whitespace or separator
    // In assign context, $var is safe (no quoting needed at word level)
    // But command substitutions might still need internal quoting
    parse_assign_rhs_word(t);
}

fn parse_assign_rhs_word(t: &mut Tokenizer) {
    loop {
        if t.pos >= t.input.len() { break; }
        let c = t.input[t.pos];
        if c == b' ' || c == b'\t' || c == b'\n' || c == b';' || c == b'&' || c == b'|' { break; }
        match c {
            b'"' => { parse_dq(t, false); break; } // After DQ, stop (simplified)
            b'\'' => { parse_sq(t); break; }
            b'$' => {
                if t.peek_at(1) == Some(b'(') {
                    if t.peek_at(2) == Some(b'(') {
                        let s = read_dollar_arith(t);
                        t.emit(TKind::Arith, &s);
                    } else {
                        t.pos += 2;
                        t.emit(TKind::CmdSubOpen, "$(");
                        parse_cmd_sub_inner(t);
                        if t.peek() == Some(b')') { t.emit(TKind::CmdSubClose, ")"); t.pos += 1; }
                    }
                } else {
                    // $var in assign context - safe
                    parse_dollar_safe(t);
                }
            }
            b'`' => {
                parse_backtick(t, false); // no outer quoting needed in assign context
            }
            _ => {
                let start = t.pos;
                while t.pos < t.input.len() {
                    let c = t.input[t.pos];
                    if c == b'"' || c == b'\'' || c == b'$' || c == b'`' { break; }
                    if c == b' ' || c == b'\t' || c == b'\n' || c == b';' || c == b'&' || c == b'|' { break; }
                    t.pos += 1;
                }
                let s = t.collect_str(start).to_string();
                t.emit(TKind::Verbatim, &s);
            }
        }
    }
}

fn parse_dollar_safe(t: &mut Tokenizer) {
    // Parse $var in assignment context (safe, no quoting needed)
    let start = t.pos;
    t.pos += 1; // skip $
    let c2 = t.peek().unwrap_or(0);
    match c2 {
        b'{' => {
            // ${...} - read until }
            t.pos += 1;
            let mut depth = 1i32;
            while t.pos < t.input.len() {
                match t.input[t.pos] {
                    b'{' => { depth += 1; t.pos += 1; }
                    b'}' => { depth -= 1; t.pos += 1; if depth == 0 { break; } }
                    _ => { t.pos += 1; }
                }
            }
        }
        _ if is_ic(c2) => {
            while t.pos < t.input.len() && is_ic(t.input[t.pos]) { t.pos += 1; }
        }
        b'@' | b'*' | b'?' | b'$' | b'!' | b'#' => { t.pos += 1; }
        _ if c2.is_ascii_digit() => { t.pos += 1; }
        _ => {}
    }
    let s = t.collect_str(start).to_string();
    t.emit(TKind::Verbatim, &s);
}

fn parse_arg(t: &mut Tokenizer, in_test: bool, term_chars: &[u8], stops: &[&[u8]]) {
    // Parse a word in command argument context
    // Multiple adjacent tokens form one "word"
    loop {
        if t.pos >= t.input.len() { break; }
        let c = t.input[t.pos];
        if term_chars.contains(&c) { break; }
        if !term_chars.contains(&b' ') && (c == b' ' || c == b'\t') { break; }
        if in_test && c == b']' { break; }
        if !in_test && c == b')' { break; }
        if at_any_stop(t, stops) { break; }
        
        match c {
            b'"' => { parse_dq(t, false); }
            b'\'' => { parse_sq(t); }
            b'$' if t.peek_at(1) == Some(b'\'') => { parse_sq(t); }
            b'$' => { parse_dollar_arg(t, in_test); }
            b'`' => { parse_backtick(t, true); }
            b'\\' if t.peek_at(1) == Some(b'\n') => {
                t.emit(TKind::Verbatim, "\\\n"); t.pos += 2;
                skip_blanks(t);
            }
            b'<' | b'>' => { break; } // redirects
            _ => {
                let start = t.pos;
                while t.pos < t.input.len() {
                    let c = t.input[t.pos];
                    if term_chars.contains(&c) { break; }
                    if c == b'"' || c == b'\'' || c == b'$' || c == b'`' || c == b'\\' { break; }
                    if c == b' ' || c == b'\t' { break; }
                    if c == b'<' || c == b'>' { break; }
                    if in_test && c == b']' { break; }
                    if !in_test && c == b')' { break; }
                    t.pos += 1;
                }
                let s = t.collect_str(start).to_string();
                if !s.is_empty() { t.emit(TKind::Verbatim, &s); }
                break; // Stop after plain text (one word)
            }
        }
        // After each token, check if next char is a word separator
        if t.pos < t.input.len() {
            let next = t.input[t.pos];
            if next == b' ' || next == b'\t' || next == b'\n' { break; }
            if next == b';' || next == b'&' || next == b'|' { break; }
            if in_test && next == b']' { break; }
            if !in_test && next == b')' { break; }
            if term_chars.contains(&next) { break; }
        }
    }
}

fn parse_dollar_arg(t: &mut Tokenizer, in_test: bool) {
    let c2 = t.peek_at(1).unwrap_or(0);
    match c2 {
        b'(' => {
            if t.peek_at(2) == Some(b'(') {
                let s = read_dollar_arith(t);
                t.emit(TKind::Arith, &s);
            } else {
                t.pos += 2; // skip $(
                t.emit(TKind::NQOpen, "\"");
                t.emit(TKind::CmdSubOpen, "$(");
                parse_cmd_sub_inner(t);
                if t.peek() == Some(b')') { t.emit(TKind::CmdSubClose, ")"); t.pos += 1; }
                t.emit(TKind::NQClose, "\"");
            }
        }
        b'{' => {
            parse_dollar_brace_arg(t);
        }
        b'@' => { t.emit_trans(TKind::UVar, "$@", "\"$@\""); t.pos += 2; }
        b'*' => { t.emit_trans(TKind::UVar, "$*", "\"$@\""); t.pos += 2; }
        b'?' | b'$' | b'!' | b'#' => { t.emit(TKind::SafeVar, &format!("${}", c2 as char)); t.pos += 2; }
        b'\'' => { parse_sq(t); } // $'...' ANSI C string
        _ if c2.is_ascii_digit() => {
            t.pos += 2;
            if t.peek().map(|c| c.is_ascii_digit()).unwrap_or(false) {
                emit_pitfall_error(t, &format!("${}", c2 as char), t.pos - 2);
                t.emit(TKind::Verbatim, &format!("${}", c2 as char));
                return;
            }
            let orig = format!("${}", c2 as char);
            t.emit_trans(TKind::UVar, &orig, &format!("\"${}\"", c2 as char));
        }
        _ if is_is(c2) => {
            t.pos += 1; // skip $
            let name = t.read_ident();
            let orig = format!("${}", name);
            t.emit_trans(TKind::UVar, &orig, &format!("\"${}\"", name));
        }
        _ => { t.emit(TKind::Verbatim, "$"); t.pos += 1; }
    }
}

fn parse_dq(t: &mut Tokenizer, _in_assign: bool) {
    assert_eq!(t.peek(), Some(b'"'));
    t.pos += 1; // skip opening "
    t.emit(TKind::DQOpen, "\"");
    
    loop {
        if t.pos >= t.input.len() { break; }
        let c = t.input[t.pos];
        match c {
            b'"' => { t.emit(TKind::DQClose, "\""); t.pos += 1; break; }
            b'\\' => {
                let nc = t.peek_at(1).unwrap_or(0);
                if matches!(nc, b'"' | b'\\' | b'$' | b'`' | b'\n') {
                    let s = format!("\\{}", nc as char);
                    t.emit(TKind::DQText, &s);
                    t.pos += 2;
                } else {
                    t.emit(TKind::DQText, "\\");
                    t.pos += 1;
                }
            }
            b'$' => {
                let c2 = t.peek_at(1).unwrap_or(0);
                match c2 {
                    b'(' => {
                        if t.peek_at(2) == Some(b'(') {
                            let s = read_dollar_arith(t);
                            t.emit(TKind::DQArith, &s);
                        } else {
                            t.pos += 2;
                            t.emit(TKind::DQCmdOpen, "$(");
                            parse_cmd_sub_inner(t);
                            if t.peek() == Some(b')') { t.emit(TKind::DQCmdClose, ")"); t.pos += 1; }
                        }
                    }
                    b'{' => { parse_dq_dollar_brace(t); }
                    b'@' => { t.emit(TKind::DQVar, "$@"); t.pos += 2; }
                    b'*' => { t.emit(TKind::DQVar, "$*"); t.pos += 2; }
                    b'?' | b'$' | b'!' | b'#' => { t.emit(TKind::DQVar, &format!("${}", c2 as char)); t.pos += 2; }
                    _ if c2.is_ascii_digit() => {
                        t.pos += 2;
                        if t.peek().map(|c| c.is_ascii_digit()).unwrap_or(false) {
                            // Pitfall in DQ context - just emit
                            t.emit(TKind::DQVar, &format!("${}", c2 as char));
                        } else {
                            t.emit(TKind::DQVar, &format!("${}", c2 as char));
                        }
                    }
                    _ if is_is(c2) => {
                        t.pos += 1;
                        let name = t.read_ident();
                        t.emit(TKind::DQVar, &format!("${}", name));
                    }
                    b'\'' => { parse_sq(t); }
                    _ => { t.emit(TKind::DQText, "$"); t.pos += 1; }
                }
            }
            b'`' => {
                t.pos += 1;
                t.emit(TKind::DQCmdOpen, "`");
                loop {
                    if t.pos >= t.input.len() { break; }
                    if t.peek() == Some(b'`') { t.emit(TKind::DQCmdClose, ""); t.pos += 1; break; }
                    let start = t.pos;
                    parse_compound_list(t, &[b"`"]);
                    if t.peek() == Some(b'`') { t.emit(TKind::DQCmdClose, ""); t.pos += 1; break; }
                    if t.pos == start { let c = t.advance().unwrap_or(b'`'); t.emit(TKind::DQText, &(c as char).to_string()); }
                }
            }
            _ => {
                let start = t.pos;
                while t.pos < t.input.len() {
                    let c = t.input[t.pos];
                    if c == b'"' || c == b'$' || c == b'`' || c == b'\\' { break; }
                    t.pos += 1;
                }
                let s = t.collect_str(start).to_string();
                if !s.is_empty() { t.emit(TKind::DQText, &s); }
            }
        }
    }
}

fn parse_dq_dollar_brace(t: &mut Tokenizer) {
    let start = t.pos;
    t.pos += 2; // skip ${
    
    let peek = t.peek().unwrap_or(0);
    
    // Handle ${#...} length - safe
    if peek == b'#' {
        t.pos += 1;
        let mut depth = 1i32;
        while t.pos < t.input.len() {
            match t.input[t.pos] {
                b'{' => { depth += 1; t.pos += 1; }
                b'}' => { depth -= 1; t.pos += 1; if depth == 0 { break; } }
                _ => { t.pos += 1; }
            }
        }
        let s = t.collect_str(start).to_string();
        t.emit(TKind::DQVar, &s); // safe, no transform
        return;
    }
    
    // ${!...} indirect - safe
    if peek == b'!' {
        t.pos += 1;
        let mut depth = 1i32;
        while t.pos < t.input.len() {
            match t.input[t.pos] {
                b'{' => { depth += 1; t.pos += 1; }
                b'}' => { depth -= 1; t.pos += 1; if depth == 0 { break; } }
                _ => { t.pos += 1; }
            }
        }
        let s = t.collect_str(start).to_string();
        t.emit(TKind::DQVar, &s);
        return;
    }
    
    // Read name
    let name_start = t.pos;
    if peek.is_ascii_digit() {
        while t.pos < t.input.len() && t.input[t.pos].is_ascii_digit() { t.pos += 1; }
    } else {
        while t.pos < t.input.len() && is_ic(t.input[t.pos]) { t.pos += 1; }
    }
    let name = std::str::from_utf8(&t.input[name_start..t.pos]).unwrap_or("").to_string();
    
    // Read suffix
    let suf_start = t.pos;
    let mut depth = 1i32;
    while t.pos < t.input.len() {
        match t.input[t.pos] {
            b'{' => { depth += 1; t.pos += 1; }
            b'}' => { depth -= 1; t.pos += 1; if depth == 0 { break; } }
            b'"' => {
                t.pos += 1;
                while t.pos < t.input.len() && t.input[t.pos] != b'"' { t.pos += 1; }
                if t.pos < t.input.len() { t.pos += 1; }
            }
            _ => { t.pos += 1; }
        }
    }
    let suffix = std::str::from_utf8(&t.input[suf_start..t.pos.saturating_sub(1)]).unwrap_or("").to_string();
    let orig = t.collect_str(start).to_string();
    
    // Check if braces can be removed
    // Can remove if: simple identifier name, nothing follows that's ident char
    let can_remove = suffix.is_empty()
        && !name.is_empty()
        && !name.as_bytes()[0].is_ascii_digit()
        && is_is(name.as_bytes()[0])
        && name.bytes().all(|c| is_ic(c))
        && {
            // Check next char in double-quoted string
            let next = t.peek().unwrap_or(0);
            // Can remove if next char is " or non-ident char
            next == b'"' || !is_ic(next)
        };
    
    if can_remove {
        // The braces can be removed: "${var}" -> "$var"
        t.tokens.push(Token { kind: TKind::DQVarRm, text: orig, transform: format!("${}", name) });
    } else if suffix == "[*]" {
        // ${var[*]} -> ${var[@]}
        let trans_orig = orig.replace("[*]", "[@]");
        t.emit(TKind::DQVar, &orig); // Just mark as regular DQ var
    } else {
        t.emit(TKind::DQVar, &orig);
    }
}

fn parse_sq(t: &mut Tokenizer) {
    let start = t.pos;
    let dollar = t.peek() == Some(b'$');
    if dollar { t.pos += 1; }
    assert_eq!(t.peek(), Some(b'\''));
    t.pos += 1; // skip '
    while t.pos < t.input.len() && t.input[t.pos] != b'\'' {
        if t.input[t.pos] == b'\\' { t.pos += 1; }
        if t.pos < t.input.len() { t.pos += 1; }
    }
    if t.pos < t.input.len() { t.pos += 1; } // skip closing '
    let s = t.collect_str(start).to_string();
    t.emit(TKind::SQ, &s);
}

        // Check for assignment VAR=...
        if let Some(eq) = find_eq_in_word(t) {
            if eq > 0 && is_is(t.input[t.pos]) && t.input[t.pos..t.pos+eq].iter().all(|&c| is_ic(c)) {
                // It's an assignment prefix
                let name = std::str::from_utf8(&t.input[t.pos..t.pos+eq]).unwrap_or("").to_string();
                t.emit(TKind::AssignLhs, &format!("{}=", name));
                t.pos += eq + 1; // skip name=
                parse_assign_rhs(t);
                continue;
            }
        }
        break;
    }
    
    // Phase 2: the command itself
    skip_blanks(t);
    if t.pos >= t.input.len() { return; }
    if at_any_stop(t, stops) { return; }
    let c = t.input[t.pos];
    if c == b'\n' || c == b';' || c == b'&' || c == b'|' { return; }
    if c == b'#' { parse_comment(t); return; }
    
    // Check for [[ ]] double bracket
    if t.sw(b"[[") && !is_ic(t.peek_at(2).unwrap_or(0)) {
        parse_double_bracket(t);
        return;
    }
    // Check for [ test
    if t.peek() == Some(b'[') && t.peek_at(1) != Some(b'[') {
        parse_test_command(t);
        return;
    }
    
    // Parse command name
    let cmd_name = parse_cmd_name_tok(t);
    let is_assign_builtin = matches!(cmd_name.as_str(), "export" | "local" | "declare" | "readonly");
    
    // Phase 3: arguments
    loop {
        skip_blanks(t);
        if t.pos >= t.input.len() { break; }
        let c = t.input[t.pos];
        if c == b'\n' || c == b';' { break; }
        if c == b'&' && t.peek_at(1) != Some(b'&') { break; }
        if c == b'|' && t.peek_at(1) != Some(b'|') { break; }
        if t.sw(b"||") || t.sw(b"&&") { break; }
        if at_any_stop(t, stops) { break; }
        if c == b'#' { parse_comment(t); break; }
        
        // Try redirect first
        if try_parse_redirect(t) { continue; }
        
        skip_blanks(t);
        if t.pos >= t.input.len() { break; }
        let c = t.input[t.pos];
        if c == b'\n' || c == b';' { break; }
        if c == b'&' && t.peek_at(1) != Some(b'&') { break; }
        if c == b'|' && t.peek_at(1) != Some(b'|') { break; }
        if t.sw(b"||") || t.sw(b"&&") { break; }
        if at_any_stop(t, stops) { break; }
        if c == b'#' { parse_comment(t); break; }
        
        if is_assign_builtin {
            // Check for name=value argument
            if let Some(eq) = find_eq_in_word(t) {
                if eq > 0 && is_is(t.input[t.pos]) && t.input[t.pos..t.pos+eq].iter().all(|&c| is_ic(c)) {
                    let name = std::str::from_utf8(&t.input[t.pos..t.pos+eq]).unwrap_or("").to_string();
                    t.emit(TKind::AssignLhs, &format!("{}=", name));
                    t.pos += eq + 1;
                    parse_assign_rhs(t);
                    continue;
                }
            }
            // Check for flags (-a, -r, etc.) - color as command
            if t.peek() == Some(b'-') {
                let start = t.pos;
                t.pos += 1;
                while t.pos < t.input.len() && is_ic(t.input[t.pos]) { t.pos += 1; }
                if t.pos > start + 1 {
                    let s = t.collect_str(start).to_string();
                    t.emit(TKind::Cmd, &s);
                    continue;
                } else {
                    t.pos = start;
                }
            }
        }
        
        // Regular argument
        parse_arg(t, false, &[b';', b'\n', b'&', b'|'], stops);
    }
}

fn find_eq_in_word(t: &Tokenizer) -> Option<usize> {
    let mut i = t.pos;
    while i < t.input.len() {
        let c = t.input[i];
        if c == b'=' { return Some(i - t.pos); }
        if c == b'+' && t.input.get(i+1) == Some(&b'=') { return None; } // += not a simple assign
        if !is_ic(c) { break; }
        i += 1;
    }
    None
}

fn parse_cmd_name_tok(t: &mut Tokenizer) -> String {
    let start = t.pos;
    let c = t.input[t.pos];
    
    // Could be a variable used as command: $var
    if c == b'$' {
        let seg_start = t.pos;
        parse_dollar_cmd(t);
        return "$cmd".to_string();
    }
    
    // Read command name
    while t.pos < t.input.len() {
        let c = t.input[t.pos];
        if c == b' ' || c == b'\t' || c == b'\n' || c == b'\r' { break; }
        if c == b';' || c == b'&' || c == b'|' { break; }
        if c == b'"' || c == b'\'' || c == b'`' { break; }
        if c == b'(' || c == b')' { break; }
        if c == b'$' { break; }
        if c == b'<' || c == b'>' { break; }
        t.pos += 1;
    }
    let name = t.collect_str(start).to_string();
    
    if is_kw_name(&name) {
        t.emit(TKind::Keyword, &name);
    } else if !name.is_empty() {
        t.emit(TKind::Cmd, &name);
    }
    name
}

fn is_kw_name(s: &str) -> bool {
    matches!(s, "declare" | "local" | "export" | "readonly" | "typeset")
}

fn parse_dollar_cmd(t: &mut Tokenizer) {
    // $var used as command - needs quoting
    parse_dollar_arg(t, false);
}

fn parse_double_bracket(t: &mut Tokenizer) {
    t.emit(TKind::Keyword, "[["); t.pos += 2;
    let start = t.pos;
    let mut depth = 1i32;
    while t.pos < t.input.len() {
        if t.sw(b"[[") { depth += 1; t.pos += 2; }
        else if t.sw(b"]]") {
            depth -= 1;
            if depth == 0 { break; }
            t.pos += 2;
        } else { t.pos += 1; }
    }
    let s = t.collect_str(start).to_string();
    t.emit(TKind::Verbatim, &s);
    if t.sw(b"]]") { t.emit(TKind::Keyword, "]]"); t.pos += 2; }
}

fn parse_test_command(t: &mut Tokenizer) {
    // [ test command with special -z/-n transformation
    t.emit(TKind::Cmd, "[ "); t.pos += 1; // [ including space
    skip_blanks(t);
    
    // Parse test args
    parse_test_args(t);
    
    if t.peek() == Some(b']') { t.emit(TKind::Verbatim, "]"); t.pos += 1; }
}

fn parse_test_args(t: &mut Tokenizer) {
    loop {
        skip_blanks(t);
        if t.pos >= t.input.len() { break; }
        let c = t.input[t.pos];
        if c == b']' || c == b'\n' { break; }
        
        // Check for -z or -n
        if t.peek() == Some(b'-') && (t.peek_at(1) == Some(b'z') || t.peek_at(1) == Some(b'n')) {
            let op_char = t.peek_at(1).unwrap();
            let next = t.peek_at(2).unwrap_or(0);
            if next == b' ' || next == b'\t' {
                let is_z = op_char == b'z';
                t.pos += 2; // skip -z or -n
                skip_blanks(t);
                // Parse the argument - will be transformed to "arg" = "" or != ""
                let (orig_arg, trans_arg) = read_test_arg_for_zn(t);
                // Emit the transformation
                // -z "$arg" -> "$arg" = ""
                // -n "$arg" -> "$arg" != ""
                let eq_op = if is_z { " = \"\"" } else { " != \"\"" };
                // The "-z " part gets red background (remove), the new format gets green
                t.emit_trans(TKind::UVar, 
                    &format!("-z {}", orig_arg), 
                    &format!("{}{}", trans_arg, eq_op));
                continue;
            }
        }
        
        let start = t.pos;
        parse_arg(t, true, &[b';', b'\n'], &[]);
        if t.pos == start { let c = t.advance().unwrap_or(b']'); t.emit(TKind::Verbatim, &(c as char).to_string()); }
    }
}

fn read_test_arg_for_zn(t: &mut Tokenizer) -> (String, String) {
    // Read the argument to -z or -n, return (orig, transformed)
    let start_pos = t.pos;
    let saved_tokens_len = t.tokens.len();
    
    // Parse the argument
    parse_arg(t, true, &[b';', b'\n', b']'], &[]);
    
    // Get the tokens that were emitted for this arg
    let arg_tokens: Vec<Token> = t.tokens.drain(saved_tokens_len..).collect();
    
    let orig: String = arg_tokens.iter().map(|tok| tok.text.as_str()).collect();
    let trans: String = arg_tokens.iter().map(|tok| tok.transform.as_str()).collect();
    
    (orig, trans)
}

fn try_parse_redirect(t: &mut Tokenizer) -> bool {
    let start = t.pos;
    
    // Skip optional fd number
    let mut i = t.pos;
    while i < t.input.len() && t.input[i].is_ascii_digit() { i += 1; }
    let fd_end = i;
    
    let op_char = t.input.get(i).copied().unwrap_or(0);
    
    if op_char != b'>' && op_char != b'<' {
        // Check for &> and &>>
        if t.sw(b"&>>") || t.sw(b"&>") {
            let len = if t.sw(b"&>>") { 3 } else { 2 };
            let op = t.collect_str_at(t.pos, t.pos + len).to_string();
            t.emit(TKind::Verbatim, &op);
            t.pos += len;
            skip_blanks(t);
            parse_arg(t, false, &[b' ', b'\t', b'\n', b';'], &[]);
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    }
    
    t.pos = i; // skip fd digits
    
    // Check for specific redirect patterns
    if t.sw(b">&") || t.sw(b"<&") {
        let len = 2;
        let op = format!("{}{}", std::str::from_utf8(&t.input[start..t.pos]).unwrap_or(""),
                        std::str::from_utf8(&t.input[t.pos..t.pos+len]).unwrap_or(""));
        t.pos += len;
        // &N or &- follows
        let fd_start = t.pos;
        while t.pos < t.input.len() && (t.input[t.pos].is_ascii_digit() || t.input[t.pos] == b'-') { t.pos += 1; }
        let full = t.collect_str(start).to_string();
        t.emit(TKind::Verbatim, &full);
        return true;
    }
    
    // <<-, <<, <, >>>, >>, >, ><, <>
    if t.sw(b"<<-") || t.sw(b"<<") {
        let is_strip = t.sw(b"<<-");
        let op_len = if is_strip { 3 } else { 2 };
        let op = std::str::from_utf8(&t.input[start..t.pos+op_len]).unwrap_or("").to_string();
        t.pos += op_len;
        
        // Check for <<< here-string
        if !is_strip && t.peek() == Some(b'<') {
            t.pos += 1;
            let op_full = t.collect_str(start).to_string();
            t.emit(TKind::Verbatim, &op_full);
            skip_blanks(t);
            parse_arg(t, false, &[b' ', b'\t', b'\n', b';'], &[]);
            return true;
        }
        
        // Heredoc
        parse_heredoc(t, start, is_strip);
        return true;
    }
    
    // >, >>, ><, <, <>, >>>
    let op_len = if t.sw(b">>>") { 3 } else if t.sw(b">>") || t.sw(b"><") || t.sw(b"<>") { 2 } else { 1 };
    t.pos += op_len;
    let op = t.collect_str(start).to_string();
    t.emit(TKind::Verbatim, &op);
    skip_blanks(t);
    parse_arg(t, false, &[b' ', b'\t', b'\n', b';'], &[]);
    true
}

impl<'a> Tokenizer<'a> {
    fn collect_str_at(&self, s: usize, e: usize) -> &str {
        std::str::from_utf8(&self.input[s..e]).unwrap_or("")
    }
}

fn parse_heredoc(t: &mut Tokenizer, op_start: usize, strip: bool) {
    let op_end = t.pos;
    skip_blanks_no_emit(t);
    
    // Read delimiter
    let mut quoted = false;
    let delim_start = t.pos;
    let raw_delim: String;
    
    if t.peek() == Some(b'\'') {
        quoted = true;
        t.pos += 1;
        let s = t.pos;
        while t.pos < t.input.len() && t.input[t.pos] != b'\'' { t.pos += 1; }
        raw_delim = std::str::from_utf8(&t.input[s..t.pos]).unwrap_or("").to_string();
        if t.pos < t.input.len() { t.pos += 1; }
    } else if t.peek() == Some(b'"') {
        t.pos += 1;
        let s = t.pos;
        while t.pos < t.input.len() && t.input[t.pos] != b'"' { t.pos += 1; }
        raw_delim = std::str::from_utf8(&t.input[s..t.pos]).unwrap_or("").to_string();
        if t.pos < t.input.len() { t.pos += 1; }
    } else {
        let s = t.pos;
        while t.pos < t.input.len() {
            let c = t.input[t.pos];
            if c == b' ' || c == b'\t' || c == b'\n' || c == b';' { break; }
            t.pos += 1;
        }
        raw_delim = std::str::from_utf8(&t.input[s..t.pos]).unwrap_or("").to_string();
    }
    
    let delim_end = t.pos;
    let op_str = std::str::from_utf8(&t.input[op_start..op_end]).unwrap_or("").to_string();
    let delim_str = std::str::from_utf8(&t.input[delim_start..delim_end]).unwrap_or("").to_string();
    
    // Skip to end of current line
    while t.pos < t.input.len() && t.input[t.pos] != b'\n' { t.pos += 1; }
    if t.pos < t.input.len() { t.pos += 1; } // skip \n
    
    // Read heredoc content until delimiter line
    let content_start = t.pos;
    loop {
        if t.pos >= t.input.len() { break; }
        let line_start = t.pos;
        if strip {
            while t.pos < t.input.len() && t.input[t.pos] == b'\t' { t.pos += 1; }
        }
        if t.input[t.pos..].starts_with(raw_delim.as_bytes()) {
            let after = t.pos + raw_delim.len();
            if after >= t.input.len() || t.input[after] == b'\n' {
                let content = std::str::from_utf8(&t.input[content_start..line_start]).unwrap_or("").to_string();
                let close_start = t.pos;
                t.pos += raw_delim.len();
                if t.peek() == Some(b'\n') { t.pos += 1; }
                let close = std::str::from_utf8(&t.input[close_start..t.pos]).unwrap_or("").to_string();
                let full = format!("{}{}\n{}{}", op_str, delim_str, content, close);
                t.emit(TKind::Heredoc, &full);
                return;
            }
        }
        t.pos = line_start;
        while t.pos < t.input.len() && t.input[t.pos] != b'\n' { t.pos += 1; }
        if t.pos < t.input.len() { t.pos += 1; }
    }
    
    let remaining = std::str::from_utf8(&t.input[content_start..t.pos]).unwrap_or("").to_string();
    let full = format!("{}{}\n{}", op_str, delim_str, remaining);
    t.emit(TKind::Heredoc, &full);
}

fn skip_blanks_no_emit(t: &mut Tokenizer) {
    while t.pos < t.input.len() && (t.input[t.pos] == b' ' || t.input[t.pos] == b'\t') { t.pos += 1; }
}

fn parse_assign_rhs(t: &mut Tokenizer) {
    // Assignment RHS - $var is safe, but $() needs parsing
    if t.pos >= t.input.len() { return; }
    
    // Array assignment?
    if t.peek() == Some(b'(') {
        t.emit(TKind::Verbatim, "("); t.pos += 1;
        loop {
            skip_blanks(t);
            if t.pos >= t.input.len() { break; }
            let c = t.input[t.pos];
            if c == b'\n' { t.emit(TKind::Verbatim, "\n"); t.pos += 1; continue; }
            if c == b')' { t.emit(TKind::Verbatim, ")"); t.pos += 1; break; }
            parse_arg(t, false, &[b'\n', b')'], &[]);
        }
        return;
    }
    
    // Regular value - parse until whitespace or separator
    // In assign context, $var is safe (no quoting needed at word level)
    // But command substitutions might still need internal quoting
    parse_assign_rhs_word(t);
}

fn parse_assign_rhs_word(t: &mut Tokenizer) {
    loop {
        if t.pos >= t.input.len() { break; }
        let c = t.input[t.pos];
        if c == b' ' || c == b'\t' || c == b'\n' || c == b';' || c == b'&' || c == b'|' { break; }
        match c {
            b'"' => { parse_dq(t, false); break; } // After DQ, stop (simplified)
            b'\'' => { parse_sq(t); break; }
            b'$' => {
                if t.peek_at(1) == Some(b'(') {
                    if t.peek_at(2) == Some(b'(') {
                        let s = read_dollar_arith(t);
                        t.emit(TKind::Arith, &s);
                    } else {
                        t.pos += 2;
                        t.emit(TKind::CmdSubOpen, "$(");
                        parse_cmd_sub_inner(t);
                        if t.peek() == Some(b')') { t.emit(TKind::CmdSubClose, ")"); t.pos += 1; }
                    }
                } else {
                    // $var in assign context - safe
                    parse_dollar_safe(t);
                }
            }
            b'`' => {
                parse_backtick(t, false); // no outer quoting needed in assign context
            }
            _ => {
                let start = t.pos;
                while t.pos < t.input.len() {
                    let c = t.input[t.pos];
                    if c == b'"' || c == b'\'' || c == b'$' || c == b'`' { break; }
                    if c == b' ' || c == b'\t' || c == b'\n' || c == b';' || c == b'&' || c == b'|' { break; }
                    t.pos += 1;
                }
                let s = t.collect_str(start).to_string();
                t.emit(TKind::Verbatim, &s);
            }
        }
    }
}

fn parse_dollar_safe(t: &mut Tokenizer) {
    // Parse $var in assignment context (safe, no quoting needed)
    let start = t.pos;
    t.pos += 1; // skip $
    let c2 = t.peek().unwrap_or(0);
    match c2 {
        b'{' => {
            // ${...} - read until }
            t.pos += 1;
            let mut depth = 1i32;
            while t.pos < t.input.len() {
                match t.input[t.pos] {
                    b'{' => { depth += 1; t.pos += 1; }
                    b'}' => { depth -= 1; t.pos += 1; if depth == 0 { break; } }
                    _ => { t.pos += 1; }
                }
            }
        }
        _ if is_ic(c2) => {
            while t.pos < t.input.len() && is_ic(t.input[t.pos]) { t.pos += 1; }
        }
        b'@' | b'*' | b'?' | b'$' | b'!' | b'#' => { t.pos += 1; }
        _ if c2.is_ascii_digit() => { t.pos += 1; }
        _ => {}
    }
    let s = t.collect_str(start).to_string();
    t.emit(TKind::Verbatim, &s);
}

fn parse_arg(t: &mut Tokenizer, in_test: bool, term_chars: &[u8], stops: &[&[u8]]) {
    // Parse a word in command argument context
    // Multiple adjacent tokens form one "word"
    loop {
        if t.pos >= t.input.len() { break; }
        let c = t.input[t.pos];
        if term_chars.contains(&c) { break; }
        if !term_chars.contains(&b' ') && (c == b' ' || c == b'\t') { break; }
        if in_test && c == b']' { break; }
        if !in_test && c == b')' { break; }
        if at_any_stop(t, stops) { break; }
        
        match c {
            b'"' => { parse_dq(t, false); }
            b'\'' => { parse_sq(t); }
            b'$' if t.peek_at(1) == Some(b'\'') => { parse_sq(t); }
            b'$' => { parse_dollar_arg(t, in_test); }
            b'`' => { parse_backtick(t, true); }
            b'\\' if t.peek_at(1) == Some(b'\n') => {
                t.emit(TKind::Verbatim, "\\\n"); t.pos += 2;
                skip_blanks(t);
            }
            b'<' | b'>' => { break; } // redirects
            _ => {
                let start = t.pos;
                while t.pos < t.input.len() {
                    let c = t.input[t.pos];
                    if term_chars.contains(&c) { break; }
                    if c == b'"' || c == b'\'' || c == b'$' || c == b'`' || c == b'\\' { break; }
                    if c == b' ' || c == b'\t' { break; }
                    if c == b'<' || c == b'>' { break; }
                    if in_test && c == b']' { break; }
                    if !in_test && c == b')' { break; }
                    t.pos += 1;
                }
                let s = t.collect_str(start).to_string();
                if !s.is_empty() { t.emit(TKind::Verbatim, &s); }
                break; // Stop after plain text (one word)
            }
        }
        // After each token, check if next char is a word separator
        if t.pos < t.input.len() {
            let next = t.input[t.pos];
            if next == b' ' || next == b'\t' || next == b'\n' { break; }
            if next == b';' || next == b'&' || next == b'|' { break; }
            if in_test && next == b']' { break; }
            if !in_test && next == b')' { break; }
            if term_chars.contains(&next) { break; }
        }
    }
}

fn parse_dollar_arg(t: &mut Tokenizer, in_test: bool) {
    let c2 = t.peek_at(1).unwrap_or(0);
    match c2 {
        b'(' => {
            if t.peek_at(2) == Some(b'(') {
                let s = read_dollar_arith(t);
                t.emit(TKind::Arith, &s);
            } else {
                t.pos += 2; // skip $(
                t.emit(TKind::NQOpen, "\"");
                t.emit(TKind::CmdSubOpen, "$(");
                parse_cmd_sub_inner(t);
                if t.peek() == Some(b')') { t.emit(TKind::CmdSubClose, ")"); t.pos += 1; }
                t.emit(TKind::NQClose, "\"");
            }
        }
        b'{' => {
            parse_dollar_brace_arg(t);
        }
        b'@' => { t.emit_trans(TKind::UVar, "$@", "\"$@\""); t.pos += 2; }
        b'*' => { t.emit_trans(TKind::UVar, "$*", "\"$@\""); t.pos += 2; }
        b'?' | b'$' | b'!' | b'#' => { t.emit(TKind::SafeVar, &format!("${}", c2 as char)); t.pos += 2; }
        b'\'' => { parse_sq(t); } // $'...' ANSI C string
        _ if c2.is_ascii_digit() => {
            t.pos += 2;
            if t.peek().map(|c| c.is_ascii_digit()).unwrap_or(false) {
                emit_pitfall_error(t, &format!("${}", c2 as char), t.pos - 2);
                t.emit(TKind::Verbatim, &format!("${}", c2 as char));
                return;
            }
            let orig = format!("${}", c2 as char);
            t.emit_trans(TKind::UVar, &orig, &format!("\"${}\"", c2 as char));
        }
        _ if is_is(c2) => {
            t.pos += 1; // skip $
            let name = t.read_ident();
            let orig = format!("${}", name);
            t.emit_trans(TKind::UVar, &orig, &format!("\"${}\"", name));
        }
        _ => { t.emit(TKind::Verbatim, "$"); t.pos += 1; }
    }

fn parse_dq(t: &mut Tokenizer, _in_assign: bool) {
    assert_eq!(t.peek(), Some(b'"'));
    t.pos += 1; // skip opening "
    t.emit(TKind::DQOpen, "\"");
    
    loop {
        if t.pos >= t.input.len() { break; }
        let c = t.input[t.pos];
        match c {
            b'"' => { t.emit(TKind::DQClose, "\""); t.pos += 1; break; }
            b'\\' => {
                let nc = t.peek_at(1).unwrap_or(0);
                if matches!(nc, b'"' | b'\\' | b'$' | b'`' | b'\n') {
                    let s = format!("\\{}", nc as char);
                    t.emit(TKind::DQText, &s);
                    t.pos += 2;
                } else {
                    t.emit(TKind::DQText, "\\");
                    t.pos += 1;
                }
            }
            b'$' => {
                let c2 = t.peek_at(1).unwrap_or(0);
                match c2 {
                    b'(' => {
                        if t.peek_at(2) == Some(b'(') {
                            let s = read_dollar_arith(t);
                            t.emit(TKind::DQArith, &s);
                        } else {
                            t.pos += 2;
                            t.emit(TKind::DQCmdOpen, "$(");
                            parse_cmd_sub_inner(t);
                            if t.peek() == Some(b')') { t.emit(TKind::DQCmdClose, ")"); t.pos += 1; }
                        }
                    }
                    b'{' => { parse_dq_dollar_brace(t); }
                    b'@' => { t.emit(TKind::DQVar, "$@"); t.pos += 2; }
                    b'*' => { t.emit(TKind::DQVar, "$*"); t.pos += 2; }
                    b'?' | b'$' | b'!' | b'#' => { t.emit(TKind::DQVar, &format!("${}", c2 as char)); t.pos += 2; }

                        t.pos += 2;
                        if t.peek().map(|c| c.is_ascii_digit()).unwrap_or(false) {
                            // Pitfall in DQ context - just emit
                            t.emit(TKind::DQVar, &format!("${}", c2 as char));
                        } else {
                            t.emit(TKind::DQVar, &format!("${}", c2 as char));
                        }

                    _ if is_is(c2) => {

                        let name = t.read_ident();
                        t.emit(TKind::DQVar, &format!("${}", name));

                    _ => { t.emit(TKind::DQText, "$"); t.pos += 1; }

        let mut depth = 1i32;
        while t.pos < t.input.len() {

                b'{' => { depth += 1; t.pos += 1; }
                b'}' => { depth -= 1; t.pos += 1; if depth == 0 { break; } }
                _ => { t.pos += 1; }
            }
        }
        let s = t.collect_str(start).to_string();
        t.emit(TKind::DQVar, &s);
        return;
    }
    
    // Read name
    let name_start = t.pos;
    if peek.is_ascii_digit() {
        while t.pos < t.input.len() && t.input[t.pos].is_ascii_digit() { t.pos += 1; }
    } else {
        while t.pos < t.input.len() && is_ic(t.input[t.pos]) { t.pos += 1; }
    }
    let name = std::str::from_utf8(&t.input[name_start..t.pos]).unwrap_or("").to_string();
    
    // Read suffix
    let suf_start = t.pos;
    let mut depth = 1i32;
    while t.pos < t.input.len() {
        match t.input[t.pos] {
            b'{' => { depth += 1; t.pos += 1; }
            b'}' => { depth -= 1; t.pos += 1; if depth == 0 { break; } }
            b'"' => {
                t.pos += 1;
                while t.pos < t.input.len() && t.input[t.pos] != b'"' { t.pos += 1; }
                if t.pos < t.input.len() { t.pos += 1; }

            _ => { t.pos += 1; }
        }

    let can_remove = suffix.is_empty()
        && !name.is_empty()
        && !name.as_bytes()[0].is_ascii_digit()
        && is_is(name.as_bytes()[0])
        && name.bytes().all(|c| is_ic(c))
        && {
            // Check next char in double-quoted string
            let next = t.peek().unwrap_or(0);
            // Can remove if next char is " or non-ident char
            next == b'"' || !is_ic(next)
        };

    }

fn parse_sq(t: &mut Tokenizer) {
    let start = t.pos;
    let dollar = t.peek() == Some(b'$');
    if dollar { t.pos += 1; }
    assert_eq!(t.peek(), Some(b'\''));
    t.pos += 1; // skip '
    while t.pos < t.input.len() && t.input[t.pos] != b'\'' {
        if t.input[t.pos] == b'\\' { t.pos += 1; }
        if t.pos < t.input.len() { t.pos += 1; }
    }
    if t.pos < t.input.len() { t.pos += 1; } // skip closing '
    let s = t.collect_str(start).to_string();
    t.emit(TKind::SQ, &s);
}

# The issue is that when diff_lcs ends in ADD mode and we emit C_ADD again,
# we get [ADD]...[@]}[ADD]" which has redundant [ADD].
# But the expected shows ...[@]}" (no color between } and ")
# This means the final [ADD] in the diff and the closing " should be in the same [ADD] block.
# i.e., diff_lcs emits [ADD][@]} and then the " follows in the same ADD run.

# The key: when diff_lcs ends in ADD mode, the caller's C_ADD is redundant.
# Solution: track what color diff_lcs ended in, and only emit C_ADD if needed.

python3 << 'PYEOF'
with open('/home/agent/src/main.rs', 'r') as f:
    content = f.read()

# Change diff_lcs to return the current color state
old = '''fn diff_lcs(orig: &str, trans: &str, out: &mut String) {'''
new = '''// Returns current color state (0=VAR, 1=REMOVE, 2=ADD)
fn diff_lcs(orig: &str, trans: &str, out: &mut String) -> u8 {'''

if old in content:
    content = content.replace(old, new, 1)
    print("added return type")
else:
    print("NOT FOUND diff_lcs")

# Also update the function to return the state
# Find and update the end of diff_lcs
old_end = '''    // Don't reset at end - caller will handle the color state
    // (We may be in ADD mode when the closing " is emitted)
}

fn suggest_diff_var'''
new_end = '''    // Return the final color state
    cur
}

fn suggest_diff_var'''

if old_end in content:
    content = content.replace(old_end, new_end)
    print("updated diff_lcs return")
else:
    print("NOT FOUND diff_lcs end")

# Also need to update the call sites - diff_lcs now returns u8
# Update ss_diff_var
old_call = '''    diff_lcs(orig_rest, trans_rest, out);
    // After diff_lcs, we may be in ADD (green) or VAR (blue) color state
    // The closing "\\"" needs to be in ADD (green) color
    // Emit C_ADD to ensure we're in ADD mode for the closing quote
    out.push_str(C_ADD); out.push('"'); out.push_str(RESET);'''
new_call = '''    let end_color = diff_lcs(orig_rest, trans_rest, out);
    // After diff_lcs, ensure we emit the closing " in ADD color
    if end_color != 2 { out.push_str(C_ADD); }
    out.push('"'); out.push_str(RESET);'''

if old_call in content:
    content = content.replace(old_call, new_call)
    print("updated ss_diff_var call")
else:
    print("NOT FOUND ss_diff_var call")

with open('/home/agent/src/main.rs', 'w') as f:
    f.write(content)

        let s = t.pos;
        while t.pos < t.input.len() && t.input[t.pos] != b'\'' { t.pos += 1; }
        raw_delim = std::str::from_utf8(&t.input[s..t.pos]).unwrap_or("").to_string();
        if t.pos < t.input.len() { t.pos += 1; }
    } else if t.peek() == Some(b'"') {
        t.pos += 1;
        let s = t.pos;
        while t.pos < t.input.len() && t.input[t.pos] != b'"' { t.pos += 1; }
        raw_delim = std::str::from_utf8(&t.input[s..t.pos]).unwrap_or("").to_string();
        if t.pos < t.input.len() { t.pos += 1; }
    } else {
        let s = t.pos;
        while t.pos < t.input.len() {
            let c = t.input[t.pos];
            if c == b' ' || c == b'\t' || c == b'\n' || c == b';' { break; }
            t.pos += 1;
        }
        raw_delim = std::str::from_utf8(&t.input[s..t.pos]).unwrap_or("").to_string();
    }

    let op_str = std::str::from_utf8(&t.input[op_start..op_end]).unwrap_or("").to_string();

    t.emit(TKind::Keyword, "[["); t.pos += 2;

fn render_syntax(tokens: &[Token]) -> String {
    let mut out = String::new();
    let mut in_dq = false;
    for tok in tokens {
        match tok.kind {

# The issue is: after DQClose, I emit RESET, then C_ARITH self-resets again.
# The result is [RESET][ARITH] instead of [ARITH].

# For regular DQ strings NOT inside [[ ]]:

# My implementation: 
# For "-z $var":
# - emit UVar with orig="-z $var", trans="\"$var\" = \"\""
#   (wait: the trans is: trans_arg + eq_op = "$var\" = \"")
#   
# But wait: trans_arg is the transformed version of $var.
# $var -> transform = '"$var"' (from UVar)
# So trans_arg = '"$var"'
# And eq_op = ' = ""'
# So: trans = '"$var"' + ' = ""' = '"$var" = ""'

# So: orig="-z $var", trans='"$var" = ""'
# trans_inner (strip outer quotes) = '$var" = ""'
# Wait no - the outer quotes are: trans = '"$var" = ""'
# starts with '"' and ends with '"' ??
# Actually trans ends with '"' (the last char of '""')
# So strip_dq would strip the first and last char: '"$var" = ""' -> '$var" = "'
# That's wrong!

# The issue: my format!("{}{}", trans_arg, eq_op) = '"$var" = ""'
# This is NOT a proper double-quoted string (it has multiple " chars)
# strip_dq on it would incorrectly strip: it starts with '"' and ends with '"'
# but the content has '"' in the middle.

# The fix: I should not try to wrap this in outer quotes.
# The transform should be just the plain text: $var" = "" without outer quotes.
# Then the rendering functions need to handle this case differently.

                skip_blanks(t);
                // Parse the argument - will be transformed to "arg" = "" or != ""
                let (orig_arg, trans_arg) = read_test_arg_for_zn(t);'''

                t.pos += 2; // skip -z or -n
                skip_blanks_no_emit(t); // don\'t emit the space between -z and arg
                // Parse the argument - will be transformed to "arg" = "" or != ""
                let (orig_arg, trans_arg) = read_test_arg_for_zn(t);'''

    print("fixed -z skip_blanks")

fn render_zn_trans(trans: &str, out: &mut String) {
    // trans looks like: '"$var" = ""' or '"$var" != ""'
    // Render with proper colors:
    // [ADD]"[VAR]$var[ADD]" = ""[reset]
    // We parse by finding the $var part
    
    // Find the $ sign
    if let Some(dollar_pos) = trans.find('$') {
        // Before $ (the opening ")
        let before = &trans[..dollar_pos];
        out.push_str(C_ADD);
        out.push_str(before);
        
        // The $var part - find end of variable
        let var_start = dollar_pos;
        let rest = &trans[dollar_pos..];
        let var_end = rest.find(|c: char| !c.is_alphanumeric() && c != '_' && c != '{' && c != '}' && c != '[' && c != ']' && c != '(' && c != ')' && c != '@' && c != '?' && c != '#' && c != '!' && c != '$' && c != '*' && c != ':' && c != '-' && c != '+' && c != '/')
            .map(|i| dollar_pos + i)
            .unwrap_or(trans.len());
        
        let var_text = &trans[var_start..var_end];
        out.push_str(C_VAR);
        out.push_str(var_text);
        
        // After the variable
        let after = &trans[var_end..];
        out.push_str(C_ADD);
        out.push_str(after);
        out.push_str(RESET);
    } else {
        // No variable - just show as ADD
        out.push_str(C_ADD);
        out.push_str(trans);
        out.push_str(RESET);
    }
}

fn parse_separator(t: &mut Tokenizer) {
    let start = t.pos;
    // & || && | ;
    if t.sw(b"||") || t.sw(b"&&") || t.sw(b"|&") {
        t.emit(TKind::Verbatim, std::str::from_utf8(&t.input[t.pos..t.pos+2]).unwrap_or(""));
        t.pos += 2;
        parse_newline_list(t);
    } else if t.peek() == Some(b'|') {
        t.emit(TKind::Verbatim, "|");
        t.pos += 1;
        parse_newline_list(t);
    } else if t.peek() == Some(b'&') {
        t.emit(TKind::Verbatim, "&");
        t.pos += 1;
        parse_newline_list(t);
    } else if t.peek() == Some(b';') && t.peek_at(1) != Some(b';') {
        // Don't consume ";" if it's part of ";;" (case terminator)

        t.pos += 1;
        parse_newline_list(t);

        t.pos += 1;
        skip_blanks(t);

input.command:
# <() causes infinite loop!
# Let me look at how <() is parsed when it's NOT after a redirect.
# In parse_arg:
# b'<' if t.peek_at(1) == Some(b'(') => {
#     t.pos += 2; // skip <(
#     t.emit(TKind::Verbatim, "<(");
#     parse_compound_list(t, &[b")"]);
#     if t.peek() == Some(b')') { t.emit(TKind::Verbatim, ")"); t.pos += 1; }
# }
# 
# But WHAT IF <() appears at the START of a statement (not as an argument)?
# In parse_simple_command, the phase 2 starts.
# "<(" is seen as a redirect (try_parse_redirect).
# try_parse_redirect sees "<" followed by "(" -> NOT a redirect! It's process substitution.
# try_parse_redirect returns false.
# Then we're still at "<(".
# parse_cmd_name_tok is called!
# parse_cmd_name_tok reads until " <\|&;)" -> reads "" (empty, because first char is '<')
# Actually: parse_cmd_name_tok reads chars that are NOT in the break chars.
# '<' is in the break chars: "if c == b'<' || c == b'>' { break; }"
# So parse_cmd_name_tok returns "" (empty).

fn do_file(content: &str, mode: &Mode, filename: Option<&str>, mut exit_code: i32) -> i32 {
    let stdout = io::stdout();
    let mut out = stdout.lock();
    match mode {
        Mode::Transform => {
            match do_transform(content, filename) {
                Ok(t) => { let _ = out.write_all(t.as_bytes()); }
                Err(_) => { exit_code = 1; }
            }
        }
        Mode::Syntax => {
            match parse_content(content, filename) {

                Err(_) => { exit_code = 1; }
            }
        }

            match parse_content(content, filename) {
                Ok(segs) => {
                    let _ = out.write_all(render_suggest(&segs).as_bytes());
                    let t = render_transform(&segs);
                    if t != content { /* changed */ }
                }
                Err(_) => { exit_code = 1; }
            }

            match parse_content(content, filename) {

                Ok(t) => { if t != content { exit_code = 2; } }
                Err(_) => { exit_code = 1; }
            }
        }
        Mode::Replace => {
            match do_transform(content, filename) {
                Ok(t) => { if t != content { /* will be replaced */ } }
                Err(_) => { exit_code = 1; }
            }
        }
    }
    exit_code

# The '\'' pattern (escaped single quote): '\'' has 4 chars:
# ' (close single quote)
# \ (backslash)
# ' (single quoted backslash is just backslash? No...)
# ' (open single quote)

# In bash: 'can'\''t' means: 'can' (literal) + \ (escape) + 't' wait no.
# Actually '\'' is: the single-quoted backslash (\' doesn't work in single quotes)
# In bash: 'can'\''t' = 'can' + \' (escaped single quote outside quotes) + 't' 
# That doesn't work either.
# Let me think: echo 'can'\''t' in bash:
# 'can' = literal "can"
# \' = backslash-escaped single quote? No...
# In bash, \' outside quotes = ' (the backslash escapes the single quote)
